papers.title: HarmoHOI: Harmonizing Appearance and 3D Motion for Multi-view Hand-Object Interaction Synthesis
papers.authors: Lingwei Dang, Juntong Li, Zonghan Li, Hongwen Zhang, Liang An, Wei Min, Yebin Liu, Qingyao Wu
papers.summary: HarmoHOI 面向多视角手-物交互生成，把同步 RGB 视频和全局对齐 3D point tracks 放进同一个扩散框架。论文的关键判断是：HOI 视频要做到多视角一致，必须显式建模跨视角共享的三维几何与运动，而不是只依赖 2D 视频先验。它把 point tracks 表示成 pseudo-video，并用 Global Motion Aligning Diffusion 将粗轨迹细化到 metric-scale 3D trajectory，对 embodied AI 中从人类交互视频合成训练数据很有价值。
methodHighlights: Mixture of Multi-view Diffusion Transformer 联合生成 RGB 与 3D point tracks
point tracks pseudo-video 表示以缩小 2D/3D 先验域差
Global Motion Aligning Diffusion 细化全局 3D 运动一致性

papers.title: ReViV: Reconstructing the Viewer and the View in 4D from Monocular Egocentric Video
papers.authors: Xiaozhong Lyu, Gen Li, Zhiyin Qian, Xucong Zhang, Marc Pollefeys, Siyu Tang
papers.summary: ReViV 从单目 egocentric video 中同时重建观看者和视野，是一个 viewer-and-view 的 4D 重建框架。它把 RGB、相机轨迹、gaze、全身动作、手部动作和深度放在统一的 Masked Generative Egocentric Transformer 中建模，避免把相机跟踪、人身运动和场景深度拆成独立任务。对 AR/机器人学习而言，这类 holistic ego 4D 表示能把人如何看、如何动、如何接触环境统一成可监督状态。
methodHighlights: joint distribution over RGB, camera, gaze, body, hand, depth
在 HoloAssist、HOT3D、ARCTIC、Aria Digital Twin、TACO 上验证

papers.title: GeoWorldAD: Geometry World Action Model for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Songyan Zhang, Jinyuan Tian, Hanbing Li, Daqi Liu, Hao Chen, Wenhui Huang, Fang Li, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Long Chen, Kuiyuan Yang, Chen Lv
papers.summary: GeoWorldAD 把自动驾驶规划放回 ego-aligned 3D space 中，强调 Vision/Video-Action 模型需要显式几何 grounding。模型同时使用当前 geometry 和 latent future geometry tokens，既约束碰撞安全，也预测短时场景演化以避免过度保守。它说明 driving world model 的核心竞争点正在从视频预测质量转向可执行轨迹与未来三维占用/自由空间的一致性。
methodHighlights: ego-aligned 3D geometry grounding for trajectory planning
latent future geometry tokens model short-horizon scene evolution
multi-scale present/future geometry iterative trajectory refinement

papers.title: Text2Villa: Hierarchical Generation of 3D Indoor Environments with Physics-Aware Analysis-by-Synthesis
papers.authors: Xiang Tang, Ruotong Li, Xiaopeng Fan
papers.summary: Text2Villa 做文本到多层室内 3D 环境生成，目标是解决多房间、垂直连通和任意多边形边界等传统 scene generation 难点。宏观层面使用多层建筑数据微调 autoregressive layout generator，微观层面用 Affordance-driven Physical-Semantic Scene Graph 表达支撑、容纳和碰撞约束。它把 MLLM 语义推理、几何碰撞检测和 analysis-by-synthesis 闭环优化结合起来，对仿真和 embodied training environment 生成很直接。
methodHighlights: A-PSSG encodes physical affordance and semantic constraints

papers.title: BoxTwin: Learning Elastoplastic Articulated Object Dynamics from Videos
papers.authors: Heng Zhang, Gehan Zheng, Kaifeng Zhang, Jay Song, Shivansh Patel, Sonny Hu, Yunzhu Li, Changxi Zheng, Peter Yichen Chen
papers.summary: BoxTwin 面向 elastoplastic articulated objects，从视频中学习可预测、可交互的数字孪生。论文强调这类物体不仅有 articulation，还会出现非线性弹性、塑性屈服和损伤累积，常规刚体或简单可变形模型很难覆盖。它把视频驱动重建、physics-aware constitutive model identification 和长时序后接触行为模拟串起来，对机器人折叠、双臂操作和可变形物体控制很重要。
methodHighlights: video-driven reconstruction of elastoplastic articulated objects

papers.title: Depth-Regularized JEPA World Models Learn More Transferable Representations from Real Outdoor Robot Data
papers.authors: Usman M. Khan
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 depth 作为几何先验加入 JEPA world model 训练，目标是在真实户外机器人视频上学到更可迁移的 latent dynamics。它将深度监督、SIGReg latent regularizer 和 training-only overparameterization 结合，用视觉里程计 probe、surprise detection 和 multi-step rollout fidelity 评估表示质量。虽然 API 提交日期早于今日，但它出现在今天官方 cs.CV new 批次中；对 world model 研究的启发是几何先验仍然能显著提高开放环境下的动态预测稳定性。
methodHighlights: depth-regularized JEPA world model from outdoor robot video
SIGReg promotes diverse but geometry-consistent latent dynamics
frozen visual odometry probes and rollout fidelity evaluation

papers.title: Closing the Loop in Humanoid VLA: Persistent 3D Object Tokens for Verifiable Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Peng Ren, Haoyang Ge, Jiang Zhao, Cong Huang, Yukun Shi, Pei Chi, Kai Chen
papers.summary: 这篇 Humanoid VLA 工作把长期 loco-manipulation 中的 object-state divergence 定义为核心问题：机器人在移动、遮挡和接触后仍要验证物体状态。Persistent Object Tokenization 维护 role-indexed 3D object tokens，把任务对象作为持续物理实体跟踪，而不是只依赖当前帧感知。它对 VLA 很关键，因为长程任务的失败常来自状态验证缺失，而非单步动作生成不足。

papers.title: Scene-SAM3D: Multi-View Scene Asset Generation Without Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Yuqi Zhang, Yadan Luo, Xiangyu Sun, Fengyi Zhang, Zi Huang, Xin Tan
papers.summary: Scene-SAM3D 把单图 3D 生成模型 SAM3D 扩展到 calibrated multi-view scene asset generation，并且不做额外 fine-tuning。它针对真实场景中的遮挡、冗余观测和跨视角不一致，引入训练自由的多视角融合与场景资产生成流程。对具身仿真和机器人操作数据构建来说，这类从多视图直接生成可用 3D scene assets 的方法很实用。
methodHighlights: training-free extension of SAM3D to multi-view scenes
calibrated multi-view observations for scene asset generation

papers.title: Splat-based 3D Scene Reconstruction with Extreme Motion-blur
papers.authors: Hyeonjoong Jang, Dongyoung Choi, Donggun Kim, Woohyun Kang, Min H. Kim
papers.summary: 这篇工作处理低光照和长曝光下的 extreme motion blur RGB-D 3D reconstruction。传统 COLMAP/pose estimation 在强运动模糊下会失效，论文用 splat-based 表示和针对模糊的重建策略提升相机位姿与颜色质量。它对机器人夜间/低照度建图很有意义，因为实际部署时 blur 往往比 benchmark 更严重。
methodHighlights: splat-based RGB-D reconstruction under extreme motion blur
handles pose failure and blurry color input

papers.title: VIDAR: Visual-Inertial Dense Alignment and Reconstruction via a Geometric Foundation Model
papers.authors: Diyari Mohammed Salih, Lingxiang Hu, Naima AitOufroukh-Mammar, Fabien Bonardi
papers.summary: VIDAR 将 SVO+IMU 的 metric odometry 与 Depth Anything 3 的 dense geometry 结合，目标是让单目 foundation model 的细节恢复获得稳定尺度。视觉惯性前端提供 camera poses、scale 和 world frame，foundation model 则贡献局部稠密几何，最终融合成全局重建。它代表一种务实路线：不完全端到端替代 SLAM，而是把 foundation depth 当成可度量系统中的几何增强器。
methodHighlights: visual-inertial dense reconstruction with SVO+IMU metric anchor
global reconstruction from metric poses plus dense local geometry

papers.title: Plenoptic Condensation: A Novel Approach to Generalized Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Brevin Tilmon, Alex DeJournett, John Leffingwell, Scott Ackerson
papers.summary: Plenoptic Condensation 提出 Generalized Scene Reconstruction 的多阶段表示，从低表达力的 soupy scene elements 逐步凝聚成更结构化、更高表达力的 scene elements。它强调 Reality Models 需要 spatially varying representational power，才能同时处理边缘、反射和平滑表面。论文展示了手机和无人机采集的 in-the-wild 重建，并突出可测量细微损伤的能力，说明重建表示正在从好看走向可量测。
methodHighlights: multi-stage condensation from low-power to structured scene elements
spatially varying representational power for Reality Models

papers.title: Exploration Matters for Escaping the Blur Trap in 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Chengbo Wang, Guozheng Ma, Jinhong Wu, Tie Ji, Yizhen Lao
papers.summary: ExploreGS 研究 3DGS 优化中的 Blur Trap，即显式 Gaussian 表示在非凸优化中容易被梯度偏置带到模糊局部最优。论文将 blur trap 分成 far-side 与 near-side 两类，并用 Random Seeding 与 Random Splitting 两个简单探索算子缓解。它提醒 3DGS 的提升不只来自网络或压缩，也来自对 densification/splitting 优化动力学的重新理解。
methodHighlights: Random Seeding for far-side blur trap
Random Splitting for near-side blur trap

papers.title: TopoGS: Planar Reconstruction via Topology-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Shanshan Pan, Jiale Chen, Yilin Liu, Hui Huang
papers.summary: TopoGS 将拓扑约束显式加入 3D Gaussian Splatting 的 planar reconstruction。现有 planar 3DGS 往往把平面作为离散集合，容易产生碎片化和边界错位；TopoGS 从多视图 segmentation 中提取全局 2D topological relationships，并把 Gaussian primitives 绑定到结构元素上。对室内重建、CAD/设计和可编辑地图来说，这种 topology-aware 表示比纯视觉质量更有后处理价值。
methodHighlights: global 2D topological relationships from multi-view segmentations
Gaussian primitives anchored to structural elements

papers.title: FF-ProCams: Feed-Forward Gaussian Splatting for Projector-Camera System
papers.authors: Ziyao Wang, Yuqi Li, Wenxing Zheng, Jiaying Chen, Chong Wang
papers.summary: FF-ProCams 面向 projector-camera 系统，用 feed-forward 3D Gaussian inverse rendering 替代耗时的 per-scene optimization。模型从稀疏多视图观测聚合几何与光度线索，并预测可重光照的 Gaussian representation。它把 3DGS 推向主动感知、投影映射和空间 AR 场景，重点是让表示能随 projector illumination 改变而不是固定 baked appearance。
methodHighlights: hybrid Mamba2-Transformer encoder for cross-view cues

papers.title: CaT-GS: Efficient 3DGS Rendering for Large Scale Scenes via Inter-frame Caching and Tile Scheduling
papers.authors: Tingjia Zhang, Bo Chen, Shengzhong Liu, Fan Wu, Guihai Chen
papers.summary: CaT-GS 关注大规模场景下 3DGS 渲染的系统瓶颈。论文指出 tile-based rasterization 存在跨帧预处理冗余、视角遮挡冗余和 tile 负载不均衡，并提出 inter-frame caching 与 tile scheduling。对实时大场景和机器人视角流渲染来说，这类系统优化可能比单纯压缩 Gaussian 数量更直接影响部署。
methodHighlights: tile scheduling to reduce rasterization load imbalance

papers.title: SPARE-GS: Structural Parsimony and Resource Efficiency for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Zhang Chen, Shuai Wan, Fuzheng Yang, Jiazhi Xia, Weiyao Lin, Junhui Hou
papers.summary: SPARE-GS 将 3DGS 中 primitive proliferation 视为全局预算约束优化问题。方法估计各空间区域的 capacity-normalized demand，并根据预算偏差协调 densification、pruning 和 termination。它的价值在于把 Gaussian 数量分配从启发式局部规则推进到资源效率明确的结构演化策略。

papers.title: Packet-Loss Robust 3D Gaussian Compression via Atomic Packaging and GNN-based Error Concealment
papers.authors: Yuxuan Tao, Xuerui Ma, Hao Zhang, Chunhua Peng
papers.summary: 这篇 3D Gaussian compression 工作关注网络传输中的 packet loss，而不是离线压缩率。Atomic packaging 将每个 anchor 的属性打包，避免部分属性丢失造成严重不一致；GNN-based error concealment 则在解码端做 prior-aware attribute inpainting。随着 3DGS 进入云渲染、远程机器人和 XR 串流，这种 transmission robustness 会越来越重要。
methodHighlights: anchor-level atomic packaging for packet-loss robustness
stratified random grouping disperses missing anchors

papers.title: VGOcc: Learning Visual-Geometric Gaussians for Vision-Centric 3D Driving Occupancy Prediction
papers.authors: Junhong Lin, Xianda Guo, Kangli Wang, Yuqi Ye, Xiaoyu Liang, Yanlun Peng, Wei Gao
papers.summary: VGOcc 做 vision-centric 3D driving occupancy prediction，用 Visual-Geometric Gaussians 表示多相机场景。论文认为只依赖图像域特征会限制 Gaussian occupancy 的体素推理能力，因此把 foundation models 提供的视觉与几何线索加入 primitive 初始化和 refinement。它对自动驾驶三维占用预测的启发是：稀疏 Gaussian 表示需要更强几何监督，而不是只追求表示稀疏。
methodHighlights: primitive initialization and refinement for surround-view driving

papers.title: RayOcc: Occlusion-Aware Ray Occupancy Estimation via Gaussian Mixture Intensity
papers.authors: Junho Kim, Seongwon Lee
papers.summary: RayOcc 把 camera-only 3D semantic occupancy 中的单 ray 建模改成多标签存在预测。论文认为一条相机 ray 上可能同时有多个被遮挡表面，因此单一 dominant depth hypothesis 不足以表达真实体积场景。它用非归一化 Gaussian mixture intensity 和 Poisson event formulation 得到区间占用概率，对处理遮挡和多层结构很有价值。
methodHighlights: Gaussian mixture intensity along each ray
Poisson event formulation for interval-wise occupancy

papers.title: CNS-Edit++: Category-Agnostic 3D Editing with Coupled Neural Shape Representation
papers.authors: Jingyu Hu, Weilong Yan, Zhengzhe Liu, Haipeng Li, Ka-Hei Hui, Hao, Zhang, Chi-Wing Fu
papers.summary: CNS-Edit++ 做 category-agnostic 3D shape editing，将全局 latent semantics 和 3D neural feature volume 组合成 Coupled Neural Shape 表示。它把原先偏 category-specific 的 CNS-Edit 推向更通用的 3D foundation model 场景，并支持局部细节编辑与结构级修改。对 3D 生成后处理来说，这类可控编辑能力是从一次性生成走向可迭代设计的关键。
methodHighlights: Coupled Neural Shape with global latent code plus 3D feature volume
co-optimization for local and semantic shape edits

papers.title: Autoregressive B-Rep Shape Generation with Parametric Surfaces
papers.authors: Dafei Qin, Rui Xu, Zeyu Shen, Kaichun Qiao, Hongyang Lin, Qixuan Zhang, Huaijin Pi, Lan Xu, Jingyi Yu, Wenping Wang, Taku Komura
papers.summary: ParaCAD 关注 CAD 中原生 B-Rep shape generation，而不是把形状退化成点云或 voxel。方法用 surface-centric tokenization 显式编码每个 face 的 surface type 和连续参数，再全局求交恢复 edges 与 topology。它对机器人装配、可制造物体生成和 CAD-to-simulation pipeline 很有价值，因为保留参数曲面比渲染友好的 mesh 更接近工程使用。
methodHighlights: autoregressive B-Rep generation from point-cloud conditions
surface-centric tokens preserve native parametric surfaces
global surface intersection recovers valid edges and topology

papers.title: Feature-Guided Diffusion for Non-Differentiable Inverse Rendering
papers.authors: Andrei-Timotei Ardelean, Michael Fischer, Tim Weyrich, Tomáš Iser
papers.summary: FIDE 用 feature-guided diffusion 做 non-differentiable inverse rendering，把 renderer 当成黑盒，只要求它能输出图像。相比把每个候选结果压成 scalar loss，方法从 ViT 提取 dense visual features，再训练 diffusion candidate proposal model。它适合那些真实渲染器、物理仿真或材质模型难以微分的场景，为 physics-aware inverse rendering 提供了更通用的搜索框架。
methodHighlights: black-box inverse rendering without differentiable renderer
ViT dense visual features guide diffusion proposal model

papers.title: Points as Tori: Fast Pointwise Signed Distance for Point Clouds
papers.authors: Nicole Feng, Ioannis Gkioulekas, Keenan Crane
papers.summary: Points as Tori 提出从带法线点云快速计算 signed distance 的解析参数化方法。它用预训练网络为每个点预测 torus curvature 和 shift parameters，从局部 tori fitting 得到可任意分辨率查询的 SDF。方法避免全局优化和空间离散化，对点云重建、碰撞检测和机器人规划中的快速距离查询很有参考价值。
methodHighlights: local torus fitting for pointwise signed distance
feed-forward prediction of curvature and shift parameters
arbitrary-resolution SDF queries without global optimization

papers.title: SaaF: Scene-Specific Ambiguity-Aware 3D Language Fields towards Interactive Real-World Object Retrieval
papers.authors: Yuga Yano, Daiju Kanaoka, Hakaru Tamukoh, Yasutomo Kawanishi
papers.summary: SaaF 是基于 Gaussian Splatting 的 3D language field，用于服务机器人在真实场景中进行交互式物体检索。它解决两个常见问题：CLIP 特征压缩导致相似物体区分度下降，以及自然语言查询本身存在歧义。通过 metric learning 和 scene-specific ambiguity awareness，它把 open-vocabulary 3D map 往可对话、可澄清的机器人检索系统推进。
methodHighlights: metric learning for instance-discriminative feature space

papers.title: CDIS: Cross-Dimensional Class-Agnostic 3D Instance Segmentation via 2D Mask Tracking and 3D-2D Projection Merging
papers.authors: Juno Kim, Hye-Jung Yoon, Yesol Park, Byoung-Tak Zhang
papers.summary: CDIS 做 zero-shot class-agnostic 3D instance segmentation，目标是让机器人在未知环境中识别未见过的物体实例。方法跟踪跨帧 2D instance masks，再与 3D superpoints 双向关联，形成 2D/3D feedback loop。它避免只把每帧 2D mask 投到 3D 后合并造成的 identity fragmentation，对 manipulation 和 navigation 的开放世界感知有实用价值。

papers.title: MuViSeg: Multi-View Segment Correspondences from Dense Geometry Priors
papers.authors: Denis Fatykhoph, Timur Akhtyamov, Konstantin Pakulev, German Devchich, Gonzalo Ferrer
papers.summary: MuViSeg 把多视图对应从 sparse keypoint/pixel level 提升到 segment level。它基于 MASt3R/VGGT 等 dense geometry priors 为分割区域构造描述子，并用 multi-view self-attention 在多个图像的 segment 集合中联合匹配。对对象级建图、拓扑导航和 scene graph 维护来说，segment correspondence 比像素对应更贴近下游语义结构。
methodHighlights: frozen MASt3R and VGGT dense geometry priors

papers.title: Fine-Detail Monocular Geometry Estimation with Self-Guided Sparse Volumetric Refinement
papers.authors: Lingyu Kong, Ruicheng Li, Ruicheng Wang, Sicheng Xu, Chengtang Yao, Jianfeng Xiang, Jiaolong Yang
papers.summary: 这篇工作针对 monocular geometry estimation 的细节过平滑问题，指出根源在于用 2D 参数化解码 3D geometry 时会混合图像近邻但三维远离的表面特征。Self-Guided Sparse 3D Refinement 将粗 point map 提升到稀疏 3D 空间中 refinement，让特征交互更符合真实三维邻近关系。它对 thin structures、小物体和精细 metric geometry 很关键。
methodHighlights: self-guided sparse 3D refinement for monocular geometry
lifts coarse point maps from 2D image space to 3D space
targets thin structures and fine local geometry

papers.title: DROID-ANCHOR: Odometry-Anchored Recurrent Metric Depth Estimation
papers.authors: Yuxuan Chen, Brook Du
papers.summary: DROID-ANCHOR 用 proprioceptive odometry 为 recurrent metric depth estimation 提供尺度锚点。单目 SLAM/flow 系统虽然鲁棒，但天然有 scale ambiguity；论文用 LSTM Update Operator 编码高频 odometry，并在 backend 中用学习到的不确定性平衡视觉重投影和里程计约束。它对移动机器人来说很实用，因为许多平台都有轮速/IMU 等低成本里程计，可以补单目视觉尺度漂移。
methodHighlights: LSTM update operator encodes high-frequency odometry
uncertainty-aware metric backend balances visual and odometry cues

papers.title: GLidE-SLAM: GL-Accelerated Indirect-Direct Embedded SLAM
papers.authors: Carlos A. Pinheiro de Sousa, Heiko Hamann, Oliver Deussen
papers.summary: GLidE-SLAM 面向 embedded visual SLAM，把直接跟踪和间接建图分离。系统在中间帧上用 OpenGL ES compute shaders 做 GPU-accelerated direct tracking，将 CPU 留给 map extension 与全局一致性维护。对无人机、可穿戴 XR 和小型机器人而言，这种 vendor-agnostic 嵌入式实现路线比只提高 benchmark 精度更接近部署问题。
methodHighlights: GPU-accelerated direct tracking on intermediate frames
OpenGL ES 3.1 compute shaders for embedded devices

papers.title: Does Robust VIO Need More Learning? Geometry-Verified Visual Measurements under Distribution Shift
papers.authors: Yangyang Ning, Shu Liang, Quanbo Ge, Tianchen Deng, Yuhua Qi, Shenghai Yuan
papers.summary: 这篇 VIO 工作提出一个克制的问题：在 distribution shift 下，鲁棒 VIO 是否真的需要把更多估计环节学习化。方法只让 SEA-RAFT 生成 dense stereo correspondences 和 uncertainty，而 temporal tracking、geometric verification 与 state estimation 仍保持显式几何。它对 Physical AI 很有启发，因为可靠部署常常需要学习前端与几何后端之间的边界清晰，而不是全栈黑盒化。
methodHighlights: minimal-learning stereo VIO under distribution shift
explicit temporal tracking, geometric verification and sliding-window estimation

papers.title: Cross-Coordinate Correspondence Pruning for Image-to-Point Cloud Registration
papers.authors: Xin Liu, Rong Qin, Huipeng Lin, Leizhi Shu, Jin Wu, Chi-Man Vong, Liang Lin, Jufeng Yang
papers.summary: 这篇 I2P registration 工作关注点云密度对 image-to-point-cloud 粗对应质量的影响。过稀会缺少 inliers，过密又会提高 outlier ratio，因此论文提出 Cross-Coordinate Correspondence Pruning 来缓解密度 trade-off。它对视觉-激光配准、机器人定位和多传感器建图很相关，因为粗匹配阶段常是最终注册精度的瓶颈。

papers.title: PRISM: Multimodal Terrain Mapping for Rover Navigation in Unstructured Environments
papers.authors: Raul Castilla-Arquillo, Carlos Perez-del-Pulgar, Levin Gerdes, Alfonso Garcia-Cerezo, Miguel A. Olivares-Mendez
papers.summary: PRISM 为非结构化环境 rover navigation 构建 RGB-D-T 多模态 terrain mapping 系统。它使用自定义传感器套件采集对齐的 RGB、depth 和 thermal 图像，并用 OmniUnet 做多模态语义地形分割。对户外机器人来说，热成像与深度/视觉融合能提升危险地形区分能力，尤其适合坡地、岩石和低可见度场景。
methodHighlights: OmniUnet vision transformer for terrain segmentation
new annotated BASEPROD and LAENTIEC datasets

papers.title: Distilling Global Traversability Priors for Image-based Affordance Prediction in Off-road Environments
papers.authors: Matthew Sivaprakasam, Samuel Triest, Micah Nye, Deegan Atha, Shehryar Khattak, David Fan, Wenshan Wang, Sebastian Scherer
papers.summary: 这篇工作为 off-road navigation 从第一视角图像中蒸馏 long-range traversability priors。它利用卫星图像计算可行导航路径，监督网络预测超出局部 depth sensing range 的可通行 frontiers。对户外导航来说，这相当于把局部几何地图和全局地形先验连接起来，减少 myopic planning。
methodHighlights: satellite imagery supervision for FPV affordance learning
image-based off-road navigation beyond local depth horizon

papers.title: Learning Adaptive Safety Margins for Visual Navigation
papers.authors: Junyi Hu, Shuaihang Yuan, Geeta Chandra Raju Bethala, Anthony Tzes, Yi Fang
papers.summary: 这篇视觉导航工作指出 fixed safety margin 在杂乱室内环境中容易过度保守或过度冒险。方法用 context-conditioned safety critic 对 RGB-D diffusion planner 的候选轨迹排序，并通过 privileged ESDF geometry 训练后蒸馏到 perception-only selector。它的价值在于把几何 clearance、CBF residual 和效率目标放到同一排序器中，用于真实 Unitree G1 humanoid 导航。
methodHighlights: adaptive clearance preference critic for visual navigation
CBF residual, detour-ratio and ESDF matching terms
teacher-student distillation from privileged ESDF to perception-only selection

papers.title: From Perception to Assistance: Open-Vocabulary Shared Autonomy for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Murilo Vinicius da Silva, Ricardo V. Godoy, Juliano Negri, Gustavo J. G. Lahr, Ranulfo Bezerra, Marcelo Becker
papers.summary: 这篇 shared-autonomy manipulation 工作用单个 RGB-D 相机理解操作者手臂/手势，并在开放词表目标选择后辅助机械臂对齐目标。它面向工业遥操作中的深度感知不足和碰撞风险问题，将感知、意图识别和局部辅助控制结合。虽然含 cs.HC 分类，但入选原因是 RGB-D、机器人操作和 open-vocabulary 物体辅助强相关，并非普通 HCI。
methodHighlights: single RGB-D camera captures arm motion and hand gestures

papers.title: FM-VLA: Force-based Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models in Contact-Rich Manipulation
papers.authors: Ruicheng Li, Qixiu Li, Ruichun Ma, Yu Deng, Lin Luo, Zhiying Du, Jianfeng Xiang, Huizhi Liang, Ruicheng Wang, Jiaolong Yang, Baining Guo
papers.summary: FM-VLA 为接触丰富操作中的 VLA 加入 force-based memory，解决视觉记忆难以区分小幅接触事件的问题。方法用 VAE 将 force histories 编码为 compact force memory tokens，并把它们作为 action expert 的额外条件。它在隐藏积木、按按钮和按次数擦盘子等 memory-dependent 任务上显示轻量力觉历史能显著提升非马尔可夫操作成功率。
methodHighlights: VAE force memory tokens from force time series
additional conditioning for VLA action expert

papers.title: Foresight Residual RL for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation with Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Yuhan Liu, Xinyu Zhang, Litao Liu, Abdeslam Boularias
papers.summary: Foresight Residual RL 研究 frozen VLA base policy 在长程、紧公差、接触丰富装配中的失败模式。论文指出只给子任务 sparse success reward 会让每个技能孤立变好，但串联后仍然失败，因为当前子任务终态对下游技能可能很脆弱。它用 foresight residual RL 强化终态质量，是把大 VLA prior 与任务级几何/接触可行性结合的方向。
methodHighlights: residual RL over frozen VLA base policy
foresight-aware rewards for downstream subtask robustness

papers.title: Test-Time Scaling for World Action Models via Zero-Shot Geometric Evaluation
papers.authors: Zesen Zhao, Minkyoung Cho, Hui shen, Boyuan Zheng, Kunxiao Gao, Yulong Cao, Z. Morley Mao
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 test-time scaling 引入 World Action Models，核心是执行动作前用额外算力评估 rollout 是否值得信任。方法用 zero-shot geometric evaluation，按 cross-view depth reprojection consistency 等几何指标选择 sampled rollouts。它说明机器人世界模型的推理预算可以由几何一致性门控，而不是只依赖语言/视觉得分。
methodHighlights: selective test-time scaling for World Action Models

papers.title: PAVXploreRL: Physical-Action-Visual World Model Reinforcement Learning with Action Exploration
papers.authors: Han Wang, Zijun Wang, Shuoshuo Xue, Rui Cao, Fenjiao Cheng, Xiaodang Liang, Roy Ka-Wei Lee
papers.summary: PAVXploreRL 关注 action-conditioned world models 在 embodied AI 中是否同时满足 physical plausibility、action adherence 和 visual fidelity。它强调只用 in-distribution action-video pairs 会限制模型对 OOD actions 的动态理解，并通过 action exploration 增强学习信号。对机器人策略评估来说，这类 PAV 目标能帮助 world model 更像可用的模拟器，而不是只生成好看的视频。
methodHighlights: world-model reinforcement learning for policy evaluation

papers.title: RynnBrain 1.1: Towards More Capable and Generalizable Embodied Foundation Model
papers.authors: Kehan Li, Bohan Hou, Minghao Zhu, Tianyi Zhang, Zesen Cheng, Zhikai Wang, Sicong Leng, Xin Li, Xiao Lin, Biying Yao, Minghua Zeng, Jiangpin Liu, Ronghao Dang, Jiayan Guo, Siteng Huang, Haoyu Zhao, Heng Ping, Yaxi Zhao, Kexiang Wang, Tong Lu, Shengke Xue, Jiahao Tang, Yulei Wang, Zejing Wang, Jianwei Gao, Shijian Lu, Chengju Liu, Jianfei Yang, Mingxiu Chen, Deli Zhao
papers.summary: RynnBrain 1.1 是多尺度 embodied foundation model family，覆盖 2B、9B 和 122B-A10B，并强化时空、物理 grounding。相较前版，它增加 contact-point prediction，并让 2B/9B 原生支持 3D grounding，使表示更贴近机器人操作。项目同时发布 RynnBrain-VLA、GitHub 与模型资源，是今天具身基础模型方向最值得跟踪的系统发布之一。
methodHighlights: RynnBrain-VLA release with project, GitHub and model resources

papers.title: World Translation: Minimizing Sim-to-Real Gap with Backward Dynamics Extraction and Unpaired Domain Translation
papers.authors: Xinchen Yao, Leixin Chang, Hua Chen
papers.summary: World Translation 处理 sim-to-real gap，尤其是接触突变等 partial observability 下历史观测无法恢复隐藏动力学的情况。方法从真实 transition 反向提取 unobservable dynamics information，再做 unpaired simulation/reality domain translation。它在 humanoid、quadruped 和 manipulator 上验证，并做 Go2 真实机器人部署，对仿真训练策略落地很相关。
methodHighlights: backward dynamics extraction from observed transitions
unpaired domain translation preserving dynamics content
sim-to-real experiments across humanoid, quadruped and manipulator

papers.title: Manifold-Guided Motion Planning for Tight Assemblies
papers.authors: Dror Livnat, Michael M. Bilevich, Michal Kleinbort, Dan Halperin
papers.summary: 这篇 motion planning 工作面向 tight rigid-body assembly，强调可行路径常位于接触点定义的 critical manifold 附近。CMG-RRT 用层次 subdivision 将采样偏向 critical manifold 邻域，并证明在标准 clearance 假设下概率完备。对装配、插入和复杂几何约束操作来说，它提供了一个显式利用接触几何结构的规划器。
methodHighlights: Critical-Manifold Guided RRT for tight assemblies
probabilistic completeness and rotational assembly benchmarks

papers.title: Receiver-Centered Robot-to-Human Handover with Grasp-Aware Object Orientation
papers.authors: Federico Biagi, Dario Onfiani, Simone Silenzi, Luigi Biagiotti
papers.summary: 这篇 robot-to-human handover 工作把接收者作为中心，根据工具和人手姿态调整交接方向。系统使用 LLM 做意图识别，并用 MediaPipe 实时 3D hand tracking，让 Franka cobot 以更适合抓取的姿态递交不对称工具。它虽然偏人机协作，但与 grasp-aware object orientation、3D hand tracking 和安全微交互直接相关。
methodHighlights: LLM intent recognition plus real-time 3D hand tracking

papers.title: Retrofitting Existing 3D Objects with Surface-Conforming Capacitive Sensing
papers.authors: Andela Ilic, Junpeng Gao, Zhipeng Li, Yijing Jiang, Rachel Schuchert, Manuel Meier, Philipp Herholz, Christian Holz
papers.summary: 这篇 SIGGRAPH 论文将既有 3D 物体表面改造成可电容感知的多点交互对象，不需要改动物体内部体积。流程先扫描真实物体获得 3D mesh，再在物理和硬件约束下生成/优化 surface-conforming sensor layout，并展开成可裁剪的 2D stencils。虽然分类是 cs.HC，但它本质是 3D 几何、制造和表面传感结合，对 tactile object augmentation 和交互式机器人环境有参考价值。
methodHighlights: unfolding optimized 3D sensor designs into 2D stencils

papers.title: Predicting Grasping Compliance in Robotic Hands through Analytical-Model-Informed Neural Networks
papers.authors: Qianwen Zhao, Long Wang
papers.summary: 这篇工作把抓取从二元 success/failure 推进到 grasping compliance prediction，关注带力工具使用时手、物体和接触如何在负载下变形。方法用 analytical-model-informed neural networks 建模耦合运动学、被动机械和接触条件下的非线性 compliance。对机器人手和工具操作来说，合规性预测比单纯抓稳更接近真实接触任务需求。
methodHighlights: analytical-model-informed neural networks for grasp compliance
models coupled kinematics, passive mechanics and contact conditions
targets forceful tool-use behavior in robotic hands

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-20
reports.summary: 2026-07-20 官方 arXiv 批次主体 42 篇，聚焦 3DGS/事件重建、驾驶世界模型、HOI 3D scene flow、VLA、触觉接触操作、机器人导航与 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的 3D 表示主线非常明确：E3DGS 关注 3DGS 的 SE(3) 等变表示，ImprovedVBGS 把 continual Gaussian Splatting 推向实时，IPU-3DGS 则从硬件侧验证 3D Gaussian 渲染能否进入边缘/传感器处理器。
几何重建仍在向“在线、低带宽、异步传感器”扩展：Event3R 把事件相机接入前馈全局 3D 重建，SemCom-3DRecon 把通信可靠性纳入移动 3D 重建，HETA++/CSS-BA/EpiDistill 则继续补强 SfM、BA 和单目深度的几何后端。
Physical AI 今天集中在接触：VTAP、BayesContact、VTLoc、Handroid、Contact-Rich Data、Tensegrity GelFoot、OptiTac 和软体操作器 sensing 都在补纯视觉策略缺的接触、力、触觉和手内状态。
VLA/embodied AI 的重点从“能听懂指令”转向部署系统：Xiaomi-Robotics-1 代表规模化真实轨迹，Fast-Slow VLA Driving 解决控制频率，AC-VLA/DAMI/SkillNav/MemoGuard 则分别处理组合泛化、动力学适配、导航记忆和安全回退。
最值得深入阅读的是 E3DGS、Event3R、Orbis 2、Xiaomi-Robotics-1、MotionForesight、VTAP Gripper、BayesContact、VTLoc、Handroid、SCAGE 和 VLMM；它们共同指向一个方向：三维表示正在成为 world models、机器人策略、触觉接触和动态场景记忆之间的共享接口。

papers.title: E3DGS: Unified Geometric-Photometric Equivariance for 3D Gaussian Splatting via Color-as-Geometry Embedding
papers.authors: Chankyo Kim, Maani Ghaffari
papers.published: 2026-07-17T01:12:26Z | [Submitted on 17 Jul 2026] | official announcement batch: 2026-07-20 (Monday, 20 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing) | listing section: cs.CV new, cs.LG cross | categories: cs.CV, cs.LG
papers.summary: E3DGS 直指 3D Gaussian Splatting 的表示瓶颈：几何参数天然随 SE(3) 变换，而颜色/SH 系数常被当作非几何信号处理，导致严格等变结构难以建立。论文证明低阶 SH photometry 可同构到 rank-2 几何张量，并把 Gaussian 属性统一提升到矩阵 carrier space。这样可以在不使用复杂 Clebsch-Gordan 张量积的情况下处理 geometry 与 appearance，并在 object vision 与 action-conditioned Gaussian world modeling 中提升坐标系变化下的鲁棒性。
methodHighlights: Unified Matrix Embedding for Gaussian attributes in gl(3)
SE(3)-equivariant 3DGS architecture without Clebsch-Gordan tensor products

methodHighlights: asynchronous event streams to globally consistent 3D point clouds
spatio-temporal voxel representation with temporal attention

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-17
reports.summary: 2026-07-17 官方 arXiv 批次主体 36 篇，聚焦 3DGS/前馈重建、world-action models、VLA、具身导航、触觉/力觉操作、机器人仿真与 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的 3DGS/重建主线很强：G2SR、Immediate 3D Gaussian Splat Reconstruction、Instant NuRec、RoGS、JADE-GS、MAGiSt3R 和 Online Neural Space Time Memory 都在把 3DGS/前馈重建/动态 NVS 推向更快、更在线、更可用于机器人或自动驾驶仿真。
World models 与 World-Action Models 从“生成未来视频”进入控制闭环：AeroAct、DriftWorld、RoboTTT、WAM steering、BadWAM 和 RxBrain 分别覆盖飞行、机器人操作、长上下文策略、鲁棒性、攻击面与视觉想象式规划。
VLA/embodied AI 论文强调把 3D、力觉、触觉、长期记忆和在线后训练接入策略：SoftNav 注入 3D scene tokens，LIFT 注入 6D force，KineFuse 和 VQ-Touch 强化触觉，MEMORA/VTM-Nav 使用经验记忆，Reflex 与 LifelongVLA 关注部署时效率和连续学习。
Physical AI 的安全与评测从单点指标转向过程和失败恢复：SafeRelBench、Interventional Causal Circuits、BadWAM、复杂抓取 benchmark 和 VOP-Nav 都把空间关系、因果诊断、对抗失配、执行链路和几何安全纳入评价。
最值得深入阅读的是 G2SR、Open-AoE、AeroAct、DriftWorld、SeeSE3、Instant NuRec、SoftNav、LIFT、RoboTTT、MAGiSt3R、Online Neural Space Time Memory 和 JADE-GS；它们共同指向一个趋势：三维表示正在从离线感知/渲染模块，变成机器人策略、世界模型和仿真系统的中间接口。

papers.title: G$^2$SR: Geometric Methods for Fast and Memory-Efficient Gaussian-based Surface Reconstruction
papers.authors: Dasong Gao, Vivienne Sze, Sertac Karaman
papers.published: 2026-07-16T01:33:37Z | [Submitted on 16 Jul 2026] | official announcement batch: 2026-07-17 (Friday, 17 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing) | listing section: cs.CV new; cs.RO cross
papers.summary: G2SR 面向 few-view surface reconstruction，把 3DGS 的高保真表示改造成机器人可用的快速、低内存几何重建管线。核心观察是：如果先得到跨视角 2D splat 对应关系，3D splat 可以由多视几何解析三角化，而不必依赖大型 Transformer 端到端回归。它用轻量前端检测/跟踪 2D Gaussian splats，再用解析后端恢复 metric-scale 3D splats，在 ScanNet、Replica、DTU 上兼顾速度、内存和几何精度。
methodHighlights: lightweight 2D Gaussian splat detection and tracking frontend
analytic multi-view triangulation backend for metric 3D splats
few-view 3DGS surface reconstruction with robot-friendly memory and runtime

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-15
reports.summary: 2026-07-15 官方 arXiv 批次主体 32 篇，聚焦 3DGS/VLA、4D 重建、world-action models、embodied VLM、机器人导航/操作和 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天最突出的主线是 3D 表示进入机器人策略：VistaVLA 把 3D Gaussian primitives 变成 VLA 上下文，DiffRadar 用 Gaussian field 做 radar SLAM，PixelLoop/Instance-Enriched Semantic Maps 则把几何拓扑和语义地图接到导航决策。
4D 与动态世界建模继续升温：AGG、SPIN-4DGS、FlowWAM、LIDAR-AD 和 DynTrace 分别从 4DGS 重建、视频原生动作表示、latent driving dynamics 和 MLLM 动态证据跟踪切入。
生成式 3D/4D 系统开始强调可纠错和可控几何：MetaView、Hallo4D、ExtraGS、RealSkin、SeamGen 和 RegHead 都在补“生成质量之外”的几何一致性、对应关系和资产生产接口。
机器人 Physical AI 的论文偏向可部署系统：DenseReward 自动合成失败轨迹，ExToken 改善 VLA-RL 探索，Jetson-PI 与 temporal redundancy 工作关注低延迟控制，MAMMOTH/GaitSpan/Robust In-Hand 则把真实传感器、形态和接触物理纳入策略。

最值得深入阅读的是 VistaVLA、FlowWAM、DiffRadar、Adaptive Gaussian Graph、SPIN-4DGS、Hy-Embodied-VLM-1.0、TerraZero、LIDAR-AD、ABot-AgentOS、DenseReward 和 Instance-Enriched Semantic Maps。它们共同说明下一阶段三维视觉表示会更紧密地服务动作、记忆、仿真和物理约束，而不是只服务离线渲染质量。

reports.summary: 2026-07-14 官方 arXiv 批次主体 26 篇，聚焦 3DGS 在线重建/mesh、3D world model、VLA/latent action、手物交互与触觉 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的 3DGS 论文从渲染质量走向系统接口：GeoGS-SLAM、Incremental Gaussian Triangulation、SalientGS、AsySplat 和 Grassmannian Splatting 分别把 Gaussian 表示接入 SLAM、显式 mesh、资源分配、长序列效率和动态表面建模。
世界模型和三维生成更强调“可探索、可执行、可约束”：ABot-3DWorld 把多模态输入变成 3DGS 世界，Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 把基础生成模型约束到 embodiment，Lumo-2/WALA/energy-guided driving world models 则围绕 latent action、预测动态和控制一致性展开。
机器人策略的空间表示正在具体化：robot-centric pointmaps、pixel action maps、object-centric slots、3D scene graphs 都在把视觉语义转成可操作的几何/对象/拓扑结构，而不是直接把图像 embedding 交给控制器。
dexterous manipulation 与 HOI 方向继续把接触关系放到中心位置：REGRIND、GraspGraphNet、EgoSteer 和 TAC-LOCO 分别从人手示范 retargeting、跨手型图结构抓取、第一人称视频预训练和触觉全身控制切入。

最值得优先深读的是 GeoGS-SLAM、ABot-3DWorld 0、Xiaomi-Robotics-U0、OmniX、Incremental Online Scene Reconstruction by 3D Gaussian Triangulation、Towards Predictive, Aligned, and Scalable Robot Learning、See like a Robot、EgoSteer、Action Map Policy、REGRIND 和 GraspGraphNet。它们共同指向一个趋势：三维视觉表示需要同时服务重建、生成、动作和物理约束。

Gaussian map expansion from both RGB observations and geometric priors

papers.title: OmniX: Any-view and Any-time 4D Reconstruction via Feed-forward Trajectory Fields
papers.authors: Yanqin Jiang, Tengfei Wang, Zhengwei Wang, Chenjie Cao, Junta Wu, Wenhan Luo, Weiming Hu, Jin Gao, Chunchao Guo
papers.published: 2026-07-12T17:05:18Z | [Submitted on 12 Jul 2026] | official announcement batch: 2026-07-14 (Tuesday, 14 July 2026 official arXiv new listing)
papers.summary: OmniX 面向大相机运动视频下的任意视角、任意时间 4D 重建。它不再逐帧预测静态点云，而是为每个像素预测稠密 3D point trajectories，并用动态 tokens 表示紧凑的 3D motion。方法将动态运动建模与静态几何预测解耦，适合处理大视角变化下的动态场景聚合。对 4D reconstruction 来说，它把 feed-forward 预测推进到可跨时间和视角的轨迹场表示。
methodHighlights: dense 3D point trajectory prediction for each video pixel
decoupled dynamic motion modeling and static geometry prediction

papers.title: Incremental Online Scene Reconstruction by 3D Gaussian Triangulation
papers.authors: Yanjin Zhu, Shaofan Liu, Jianke Zhu

papers.summary: 这篇论文提出直接从 dense geometric Gaussians 增量三角化显式 mesh 的在线场景重建框架。它避免先离线把 3DGS 转成隐式场再抽 mesh 的中间步骤，使渲染表示和下游几何表面可以同步更新。关键算法是 direct meshing 与 plane-based pulling constraint，用于让 Gaussian primitives 动态贴合局部表面。对机器人地图和 XR 系统来说，它把 3DGS 的可视化优势与显式 mesh 的可操作性接在一起。

incremental mesh extraction and update during online reconstruction
plane-based pulling constraint for local surface alignment

papers.title: AsySplat: Efficient Asymmetric 3D Gaussian Splatting for Long-Sequence Scene Modeling

papers.title: Grassmannian Splatting I: Moving rank-2 Spacetime Surfels for Dynamic Scene Rendering

Grassmannian parameterization of normals and velocity

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-13
reports.summary: 2026-07-13 官方 arXiv 批次主体 23 篇，聚焦生成先验到机器人执行、3DGS/SfM 系统化、触觉接触操作与全景/world model；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的主体论文非常集中在“生成先验如何进入可执行物理系统”：GenVid2Robot、PhysV2A、DemoBridge 和 AgenticFocus 都在解决从视频/人类示范到机器人轨迹之间的几何、抓取、碰撞和可达性断层。
3DGS 和几何 foundation model 正在向系统接口化发展：StereoSplat+ 追求单 stereo pair 因果重建，SplatCtrl 把 Gaussians 变成控制安全约束，AnythingReality 把在线 3DGS 接进 VR/VLM 交互，Glob3R 与 Co-VGGT 则把 foundation prediction 转成 SfM/共视可用信号。
触觉与接触成为 Physical AI 的关键变量：TactiDex 和 TACTIC 都不满足于运动学模仿，而是把 tactile/contact supervision、contact Jacobian 和 MPC 纳入操作闭环。
world model 的几何归纳偏置更明确：PanoWorld 使用全景旋转等变性和 ray-conditioning，CD-LAM 从因果角度清理 latent action，MultiView-Bench 则指出 VLM 的多视角 3D 融合仍是短板。

最值得优先深读的是 Video Generation Models are General-Purpose Vision Learners、SplatCtrl、GenVid2Robot、Glob3R、StereoSplat+、Hydra++、TactiDex、TACTIC、Causally Debiased Latent Action Model、PanoWorld 和 What VGGT Knows About Overlap。它们共同说明三维视觉下一阶段的关键不是单点指标，而是能否把生成先验、几何估计、接触状态和控制可行性放进同一个闭环。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-10
reports.summary: 2026-07-10 官方 arXiv 批次主体 22 篇，聚焦 physics-ready mesh/3DGS、HOI 接触控制、world-action models、VLA/机器人规划与仿真基础设施；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的主体不缺论文，关键变化是“生成/重建结果能不能进入物理闭环”：HoloTetSphere、ContactMimic、EVIS、DexVerse、Track2Map 都把几何、接触、传感器或 benchmark 明确接到可执行系统中。
3DGS 继续向大场景、动态场景和非刚性场景扩展：PanoLOG 解决全景大场景分块，MoE-GS/MoDE 研究动态形变专家，Track2Map 则把 deformable 3DGS 推入在线手术 SLAM。
HOI/手物交互和 articulated objects 的热度很高：GIRAF、ContactMimic、DexVerse、AnyDexRT 分别从全身交互生成、接触控制、基准覆盖和遥操作 retargeting 补上 Physical AI 的关键接口。

world model 与 VLA 的焦点从“更大模型”转向“合适表征”：EgoWAM 比较 Pixel/DINO/3D flow world targets，Native Video-Action Pretraining 从视频动作 tokenizer 和因果预训练重做 embodied foundation model，APIVOT 与 WCog-VLA 则把视觉想象、3D 状态和未来轨迹合进规划。
生成内容的几何意识继续增强：DreamCharacter-1、SkelGen4D、Canvas360、GRE-Diff 共同指向一个方向，即 3D/4D 资产、全景图和室内布局生成需要可控结构，而不只是好看的像素。

papers.summary: FabriVLA 证明 1B 级 VLM 也能通过合适动作头在多任务操作中取得强表现。它以 InternVL3.5 为视觉语言 backbone，接入 flow-matching action head，并在动作 token 间使用 gated self-attention。浅层 VLM 融合用于补充空间上下文，训练则从预训练 VLM 和随机初始化 action head 做单阶段联合优化。对 VLA 系统构建来说，它提供了一条轻量但精度导向的路线。

single-stage joint optimization for multi-task manipulation

papers.summary: 这篇提出 LingBot-VA 2.0，主张机器人控制不应直接复用为数字内容生成而训练的视频生成模型。它从头构建 video-action foundation model，引入语义视觉-动作 tokenizer、严格因果预训练、稀疏 MoE backbone 和异步闭环推理。模型在执行动作的同时预测未来 latents，并用最新观测重新 grounded。对 Physical AI 来说，这篇清楚区分了“会生成视频”和“能服务闭环控制”的模型设计。
methodHighlights: semantic visual-action tokenizer aligned with instruction following and action precision
causal video-action pretraining from scratch for embodiment
asynchronous closed-loop inference with learned forward dynamics

methodHighlights: multi-arm and multi-hand embodiment support with configurable visual variation
3,180 demonstrations with RGB, depth, point-cloud, state and proprioceptive observations

imagined future visual states for geometric feasibility checks
modality selection behavior that improves planning success and efficiency

papers.summary: Track2Map 把 deformable 3D Gaussian Splatting 推向机器人微创手术中的在线 SLAM。它不依赖准确相机轨迹先验，而是直接从手术视频联合优化相机轨迹和可变形 3D 场景表示。dense 2D point tracks 用于 deformation initialization，并通过 track statistics 区分相机运动和组织形变来降低 drift。对动态/非刚性场景重建，这篇提供了医疗机器人场景下的强约束案例。

papers.summary: Latent Memory Palace 研究连续控制策略如何拥有可变长度、可解释的 latent reasoning。它不在语言空间里推理，而是把信息组织为 autoregressive latent distribution，并将 reasoning 视为 variational inference。由此得到的 LMP-policy 能自适应分配 test-time compute，并产生 variable-length action tokenizer。虽然不直接做 3D 重建，但它对机器人 world model 和控制推理的启发在于：空间动作推理可以发生在连续 latent memory 中。

latent-space reinforcement learning to optimize the variational lower bound
adaptive test-time compute and variable-length action tokenizer

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-09
reports.summary: 2026-07-09 官方 arXiv 批次主体 28 篇，聚焦 sim-ready 3D/world engines、3DGS/SLAM、VLA 记忆与触觉、world model 可信评测和 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的核心信号是 sim-ready 世界正在取代“只可观看”的三维生成：CARLA-GS、EmbodiedGen V2、RoboSnap、SPEAR 和 WildCity 都把重建/生成结果接到物理执行、闭环评测或策略训练里。
3DGS 的使用继续从新视角合成外扩到机器人地图和仿真基础设施：GeoGS-SLAM 做 geometry-only Gaussian SLAM，NoDrift3R 处理长序列 pose drift，RoboSnap 和 CARLA-GS 则把 Gaussian 场景变成可交互 sim layer。
VLA/机器人操作的重点明显转向“状态、记忆、触觉与注意力”的结构化接入：GeoProp 显式对齐本体状态和视觉 token，LaMem-VLA/NativeMEM 处理长程记忆，Pelican-VLA 诱导接触区域注意，TouchWorld 把触觉 world model 接进灵巧操作闭环。
world model 的评测与可信度开始变得更严肃：Admissibility for World-Model Simulators 指出视觉质量不能替代动作响应验证，Instruction Leakage 论文提醒语言目标可能污染 spatial grounding，Geometric Collapse 则说明 dense geometry model 仍缺少物理因果自检。
场景级理解正在向长期、跨视场、多主体和人类协作扩展：PUF 关注 uncertainty-aware 3D scene graph 融合，SpaR3D-MoE 做稀疏视图 3D 推理，G-PROBE/CILC 处理多机器人定位与安全，CoMind 为 human-object interaction 和协作辅助提供带 3D scans 的数据资源。

papers.authors: Kaicong Huang, Meng Ma, Ruimin Ke

papers.summary: CARLA-GS 把自动驾驶长尾场景生成拆成可编辑 Gaussian 场景、LLM 场景推理和 CARLA 物理执行三个模块。它从真实驾驶数据重建几何一致的可编辑场景，再由多智能体 LLM 生成风险交互和 waypoint，最后用 CARLA/PID 保证轨迹具备运动学与动力学可执行性。相比端到端视频生成，这个框架更强调语义意图、物理可行性和自车视角渲染之间的闭环。对自动驾驶 world model 和仿真评测而言，它是今天最值得深读的系统论文之一。
methodHighlights: editable Gaussian scene reconstruction from real driving logs
multi-agent LLM scene reasoning for risky interaction synthesis
CARLA physics execution with ego-centric Gaussian rendering

papers.title: EmbodiedGen V2: An Agentic, Simulation-Ready 3D World Engine for Embodied AI
papers.authors: Xinjie Wang, Liu Liu, Taojun Ding, Andrew Choi, Chaodong Huang, Mengao Zhao, Ziang Li, Jackson Jiang, Chunlei Yu, Shengxiang Liu, Wei Xu, Zhizhong Su
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: EmbodiedGen V2 试图把 3D 资产生成推进到可直接训练策略的 sim-ready 世界生成。论文把跨模拟器资产、交互 affordance、任务驱动场景、多房间环境和 stateful vibe coding 统一到一个可编辑流水线中。实验中生成环境可以支持 manipulation、navigation、mobile manipulation 和 real-robot transfer，说明其重点不只是视觉质量，而是生成后能否被机器人策略使用。它对三维生成研究的启发是：生成结果需要带碰撞、任务和可执行状态，而不是只输出静态 mesh。
methodHighlights: unified sim-ready representation for task-driven 3D worlds
agentic generation/editing pipeline across assets, scenes and affordances
generated environments used for policy training and real-robot transfer

papers.title: GeoGS-SLAM: Geometry-Only Gaussian Splatting for Dense Monocular SLAM
papers.authors: Lipu Zhou, Yaoyun Kang, Junxiang Pang, Shengkai Sun, Tingting Bao, Kehan Wang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: GeoGS-SLAM 直接质疑 3DGS-SLAM 是否必须同时优化外观和几何，答案是对机器人任务而言几何可能更关键。它提出 Geometry-only Gaussian Splatting，只保留空间参数，从而减少超过 80% 的 per-primitive 参数，并强化光照变化下的鲁棒性。系统还用局部平面初始化和 loop closure 后的全局 Gaussian map 更新避免地图撕裂。对 dense monocular SLAM 来说，这篇提供了一个很清晰的方向：3DGS 可以被压成几何优先的在线地图表示。
methodHighlights: geometry-only Gaussian primitives with far fewer parameters
single-view/multi-view geometric supervision and local-plane initialization
loop-closure map update that globally transforms the Gaussian map

papers.title: NoDrift3R: Raymap-Guided Coupling for Drift-Robust Unposed Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Xiangyu Sun, Liu Liu, Seungkwon Yang, Jingbing Han, Seungtae Nam, Zhizhong Su, Eunbyung Park
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: NoDrift3R 聚焦 pose-free feed-forward 3DGS 在长序列中容易累积相机漂移的问题。论文认为仅依赖 SfM pseudo pose 或渲染监督都会把几何与位姿优化纠缠起来，因此引入 Raymap-Guided Coupling，把 Gaussian 中心锚定到 raymap 几何并联合优化 RGB、raymap 一致性和相机正则。Dual-Frequency Viewpoint Scheduling 进一步用 easy-to-hard 间隔扩展和短间隔回放稳定训练。它对快速重建系统的价值在于把姿态鲁棒性作为 feed-forward 3D 重建的核心瓶颈来处理。
methodHighlights: Raymap-Guided Coupling between geometry, appearance and pose
unified RGB reconstruction, raymap consistency and camera regularization objective
dual-frequency viewpoint scheduling for long sequence stability

analysis of scalability, extrapolation and uncertainty in simulation-ready digital twins

papers.authors: Shujie Zhang, Jingkun Yi, Weipeng Zhong, Zirui Zhou, Yangkun Zhu, Hanqing Wang, Xudong Xu, Weinan Zhang, Chunhua Shen

papers.summary: PUF 研究在线 3D scene graph 生成中的增量融合问题，指出现有方法通常忽略 observation、2D model 和 3D representation 三类不确定性。它把节点关联改写成语义与空间因素上的概率似然，而不是二值门控；再用 Dirichlet evidence accumulation 在候选之间分配类别和关系证据。该框架可接入 3D Gaussian 或 voxel backend，并保持实时延迟。对长期三维场景理解和机器人空间记忆来说，它提供了训练无关、表示无关的 uncertainty-aware 融合思路。

papers.title: SpaR3D-MoE: Adaptive 3D Spatial Reasoning from Sparse Views Meets Geometry-Inductive Mixture-of-Experts
papers.authors: Haida Feng, Hao Wei, Haolin Wang, Shiwei Li, Chade Li, Yihong Wu
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.AI
papers.summary: SpaR3D-MoE 面向 MLLM 从稀疏 RGB 输入进行 3D 空间推理的问题，避免依赖昂贵 3D 专用数据。方法先做自适应时空流形采样，构建 geometry-aware spatiotemporal graph 来减少冗余并保留拓扑连通性。随后引入 geometry-inductive MoE，由 instruction-pose-aware router 将多模态 token 分发给不同专家，缓解单一融合模块的模态竞争。它适合关注 3D-LLM、VSI-Bench、ScanQA/SQA3D 的读者。
methodHighlights: adaptive spatiotemporal manifold sampling from sparse RGB views
strong spatial reasoning results on VSI-Bench, ScanQA and SQA3D

papers.title: GeoProp: Grounding Robot State in Vision for Generalist Manipulation
papers.authors: Guoyang Zhao, Quanhao Qian, Gongjie Zhang, Wenhao Li, Jiuniu Wang, Xiaowei Lu, Deli Zhao, Ran Xu
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI
papers.summary: GeoProp 针对 VLA/机器人策略中 proprioception 与视觉 token 脱节的问题，提出轻量可插拔适配器。它把机器人状态投影到图像平面采样局部视觉特征，构造 grounded state token，并用 FiLM 把状态空间先验注入对应视觉特征。为捕捉动作意图，GeoProp 还从短时运动预测坐标采样 look-ahead visual context。它的贡献不在于更大模型，而是让 3D kinematics 与 2D perception 建立显式几何对应。
methodHighlights: project robot proprioception into image-space visual features
grounded state token plus FiLM spatial priors
look-ahead feature sampling from recent kinematics

papers.title: Dual Latent Memory in Vision-Language-Action Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Hongyu Qu, Jianzhe Gao, Xiaobin Hu, Shaohuan Yang, Xinlei Yu, Rui Yan, Wenguan Wang, Xiangbo Shu, Shuicheng Yan
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇提出 LaMem-VLA，把历史经验重构为短期和长期 latent memory tokens，并直接插入 VLA 连续嵌入空间。它用 curator、seeker、condenser、weaver 四个组件组织历史、检索相关证据、压缩成 latent token，再与当前 observation/instruction 共同参与推理。相比把记忆放在策略外部或简单扩大观察窗口，这种设计让历史经验在同一个 latent reasoning space 中参与动作形成。对长程操作任务，它提供了一个内生记忆范式。
methodHighlights: short-term and long-term latent memory vaults for VLA models
retrieval and condensation of historical evidence into compact memory tokens
memory tokens woven into the same embedding sequence as current observation and instruction

papers.title: NativeMEM: Native Memory Compression for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Ziye Wang, Modi Shi, Chaojun Ni, Jiazhi Yang, Mengdi Li, Zhizhong Su, Tianwei Lin, Hongyang Li
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: NativeMEM 同样关注 VLA 长程历史，但更强调高频更新和低延迟。它复用 VLA 自身 vision encoder，把每个历史帧和相机视角压缩成单个 token，直接追加到输入序列中。训练上先用 frozen VLA 监督通用 memory tokenizer，再进行任务微调。结果表明这种原生记忆压缩可以在不引入外部 planner 或新记忆模块的前提下显著提升长程 manipulation 成功率。
methodHighlights: repurpose the VLA vision encoder as native memory tokenizer
compress each historical frame/view into one memory token
low-latency long-horizon memory without external planner

papers.title: Pelican-VLA 0.5: Attending Before Acting Benefits Generalization
papers.authors: Zeyuan Ding, Wenhai Liu, Yang Xu, Jiayu Hu, Yinda Chen, Yi Zhang, Yong Dai, Jian Tang, Xiaozhu Ju
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.LG
papers.summary: Pelican-VLA 0.5 把视觉语言理解、未来帧生成和动作预测放进统一架构，关注 attention-level generalization。论文观察到其 action pathway 在没有对象标注、分割 mask、attention supervision 或任务微调时，已经能聚焦到指令相关物体和接触区域。作者把这一行为归因于 perception 与 action 之间的 learnable Reasoning Slots，它们形成紧凑瓶颈并诱导 manipulation-centric attention。对 VLA 研究而言，这篇强调“先关注哪里，再决定怎么动”可能是泛化关键。
methodHighlights: unified architecture for VLU, future-frame generation and action prediction
learnable Reasoning Slots between perception and action
emergent manipulation-centric attention without explicit attention supervision

papers.title: TouchWorld: A Predictive and Reactive Tactile Foundation Model for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.authors: Jianyi Zhou, Feiyang Hong, Yunhao Li, Yicheng Zhao, Yongjue Cen, Zirui Liu, Jiakang Huang, Zirui Chen, Ruiyang Zhang, Weizhuo Zhu, Xuhua Song, Shuo Yang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: TouchWorld 把触觉作为既能预测接触演化、又能快速闭环修正的基础模型信号。它采用层级策略：高层做 vision-language subtask planning 并预测 tactile subgoals，中层生成 visuo-tactile goal-conditioned action chunks，低层用最近触觉和本体反馈做高频残差修正。相比把 touch 当作低频观测流，TouchWorld 明确分离语义规划、接触世界模型和局部反应控制。对灵巧操作和 Physical AI 来说，这篇说明“隐藏接触状态”不能只靠视觉语言补足。
methodHighlights: hierarchical split of VLA planning, tactile world-model prediction and tactile residual control
tactile subgoals as predictive contact references
high-frequency tactile refinement for slip, force and contact stability

papers.title: Compositional Motion Generation from Demonstration with Object-Centric Neural Fields
papers.authors: Ahmet Ercan Tekden, Yasemin Bekiroglu
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇把 learning from demonstration、object-centric neural fields 和 motion primitives 结合起来做可组合机器人运动生成。方法用 canonical neural fields 与 latent-conditioned deformations 表达物体级几何变化，再由 temporal MoE 将 object-conditioned movement primitives 组合成完整轨迹。它的优点是把视觉结构和动作生成放在共享对象表示上，从而支持跨场景配置的系统泛化。对长期 manipulation，它提供了一种比纯图像策略更可解释、更数据高效的空间-时间组合建模路径。
methodHighlights: object-centric neural fields with latent-conditioned deformations
temporal MoE over object-conditioned movement primitives
compositional learning from demonstration in 3D scene representations

papers.title: Scaling Mixture-of-Experts Video Pretraining for Embodied Intelligence
papers.authors: Shuailei Ma, Jiaqi Liao, Xinyang Wang, Jingjing Wang, Chaoran Feng, Zijing Hu, Chong Bao, Zichen Xi, Yuqi Gan, Weisen Wang, Yanhong Zeng, Qin Zhao, Zifan Shi, Wei Wu, Hao Ouyang, Qiuyu Wang, Shangzhan Zhang, Jiahao Shao, Yipengjing Sun, Liangxiao Hu, Lunke Pan, Nan Xue, Kecheng Zheng, Yinghao Xu, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Ka Leong Cheng
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇提出 LingBot-Video，一个面向 embodied intelligence 的 MoE 视频预训练范式。作者认为通用视频生成模型偏向视觉保真和创意，而机器人需要效率、物理合理性和动作理解，因此从架构、数据和奖励三个层面调整。数据侧加入 robot-oriented footage、manipulation、navigation 和 egocentric 视角；训练侧用多维奖励约束 physical rationality 与 task completion。它与 VLA/world model 趋势相呼应：视频基础模型正在被重新调校为物理行动模型的底座。
methodHighlights: DiT-based MoE video pretraining tailored for embodied intelligence
data profiling with robot-oriented, navigation and egocentric footage
multi-dimensional rewards for physical rationality and task completion

papers.title: Infinite Worlds with Versatile Interactions
papers.authors: Zelin Gao, Qiuyu Wang, Jiapeng Zhu, Jingye Chen, Zichen Liu, Qingyan Bai, Jiahao Wang, Yufeng Yuan, Hanlin Wang, Yichong Lu, Ka Leong Cheng, Haojie Zhang, Jian Gao, Tianrui Feng, Yuzheng Liu, Yao Yao, Yinghao Xu, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Hao Ouyang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Infinite Worlds / LingBot-World 2.0 面向长时、实时、多交互元素的生成式 world simulator。它通过 causal pretraining 维持无界交互时长，并蒸馏实时版本以支持 720p 60fps 视频流。系统扩展了攻击、射箭、施法、射击等动作，并加入 pilot/director agent 负责角色行为与环境元素生成。它更偏交互世界生成，但对具身智能有启发：world model 正在从短视频预测走向实时可玩环境。
methodHighlights: causal pretraining for unbounded interaction horizon
agentic harness with pilot and director agents for behavior and environment synthesis

papers.title: Validate the Dream Before You Trust Its Verdict: Admissibility for World-Model Simulators
papers.authors: Christian Oefinger, Finn Rasmus Schaefer, Korbinian Moller, Mattia Piccinini, Johannes Betz
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.SE
papers.summary: 这篇不是提出新渲染模型，而是提出 world-model simulator 作为测试 oracle 前必须先被认证的问题。作者认为 FVD 等视觉指标不能保证模型对动作响应正确，尤其不能支撑安全结论。论文借鉴 VV&A、SOTIF 和场景测试标准，定义 L0-L4 admissibility ladder，并在自动驾驶 world models 上展示视觉质量与动作鲁棒性可能排序相反。它对机器人和自动驾驶很重要，因为 learned simulator 的 verdict 不能天然等价于真实安全证据。
methodHighlights: admissibility ladder for world-model simulators used as test oracles
separation of visual fidelity from action-following and closed-loop verdict validity
safety-critical simulation framing using VV&A and SOTIF practices

papers.title: Grounding Spatial Relations in a Compact World Model: Instruction Leakage and a Goal-Free Dynamics Fix
papers.authors: Yufeng Wang, Lu Wei, Haibin Ling
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.AI
papers.summary: 这篇研究紧凑 world model 中空间关系 grounding 是否真的来自感知，而不是直接抄写指令。作者发现 goal-conditioned predictor 可以在 relation readout 上很高，但去掉目标后接近随机，加入反事实指令时预测 anchors 会跟随错误指令。论文把这种问题称为 instruction leakage，并建议把 goal 从 dynamics 中移出，让它只进入 planner cost，同时监督 read path。对语言条件 world model 和机器人桌面任务评测而言，这篇是一个重要的诊断提醒。
methodHighlights: counterfactual protocol for detecting instruction leakage in goal-conditioned world models
goal-free dynamics fix that keeps goal in planner cost rather than dynamics
supervised read path for instruction-independent spatial grounding

papers.title: Ego-Human Motion Prediction with 3D-Aware LLM
papers.authors: Yujin Bae, Jaewoo Jeong, Hyeonseong Kim, Kuk-Jin Yoon
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Ego3DLM 面向第一人称视角下的人体运动预测，强调 AR/VR、协作机器人和 embodied AI 都需要 3D 场景语义约束。它用三点 tracking、3D scene features 和 egocentric video，同步解码过去/未来姿态以及过去/未来 narration。训练分为 3D 空间语义预训练、四输出 holistic instruction tuning 和基于 GRPO 的奖励微调。对人机协作场景，这篇展示了运动预测不应与语义描述分开建模。
methodHighlights: 3D scene-grounded LLM for egocentric human motion prediction
single autoregressive pass for past/future pose and narration
GRPO finetuning with intra-modal and inter-modal rewards

papers.title: CoMind: Understanding Collaborative Human Activity from Multiple Minds and Views
papers.authors: Alexey Gavryushin, Dingxi Zhang, Zhao Huang, Alexandros Delitzas, Jiaqi Chen, Ben Ellis, Cedric Zoellner, Manthan Patel, Manuel Kaufmann, Marc Pollefeys, Xi Wang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: CoMind 是一个多视角协作人类活动数据集，聚焦 cooking 场景中的 joint attention、social cues、agent-object interactions 和 handover prediction。它同时包含 egocentric/exocentric video、高质量音频、gaze tracking、3D scene/object scans 以及丰富时间对齐标注。虽然不是传统 HOI 视频生成论文，但它提供了带 3D 扫描和物体交互标注的人类协作数据。对机器人主动辅助和 human-object interaction 感知任务，它值得作为数据资源关注。
methodHighlights: 3D scene and object scans plus gaze, audio and social/object annotations
benchmarks for joint attention, object interaction anticipation and collaborative handover

papers.title: PLED-VINS: A Point-Line Event-Based Visual Inertial SLAM for Dynamic Environments
papers.authors: Seunghun Lee, Jihun Nam, Dong-Uk Seo, Hyun Myung
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: PLED-VINS 用事件相机和 IMU 做动态环境中的 monocular visual-inertial SLAM。它用 entropy-recency score map 衡量点/线特征的时间可靠性，并在统一 point-line robust bundle adjustment 中估计几何可靠性。随后通过自适应权重融合时间与几何可靠性，抑制移动物体和快速运动带来的不可靠观测。对 event-based SLAM 来说，这篇的价值在于把动态场景可靠性显式纳入状态估计。
methodHighlights: entropy-recency temporal reliability map for point and line events
adaptive temporal/geometric reliability weighting in dynamic scenes

papers.title: G-PROBE: Cross-FOV Place Recognition and Certainty-Coupled Localization for 3D Point Clouds
papers.authors: Jinseop Lee
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: G-PROBE 研究不同视场 LiDAR/点云传感器之间的 place recognition 和全局定位。它用 virtual sensor decomposition 枚举 cross-FOV 分支，编码 heading hypotheses，并用 score-scale-invariant gamma-SGRT 抑制部分视场下的 heading aliasing。后端 CG-GICP 只在高确定性共同观测点上细化 6-DoF 位姿，把描述子评分和度量配准耦合起来。对多传感器机器人定位和跨平台地图复用，它是一个实用的 learning-free 方案。
methodHighlights: virtual sensor decomposition for cross-FOV point-cloud place recognition
score-scale-invariant gamma-SGRT for heading ambiguity suppression
certainty-coupled GICP over high-confidence co-observed points

papers.title: CILC: Cryptographically-secure Inter-agent Loop Closure Candidate Detection for Multi-Agent Collaborative SLAM
papers.authors: Andrew Fishberg, Yixuan Jia, Jonathan P. How
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: CILC 关注 collaborative SLAM 中 inter-agent loop closure descriptor 交换带来的隐私泄漏。作者先展示恶意 swarm 成员可以从公开 global descriptor 广播中近似重建诚实机器人图像和轨迹，再用 Secure Multi-Party Computation 只保护 loop closure candidate detection 的相似度比较步骤。这样既避免全流程加密的过高成本，也把最敏感的信息交换变成私密计算。对多机器人 3D 建图系统来说，它把安全与几何定位问题放在同一个工程约束下。
methodHighlights: privacy attack analysis on public global descriptors in collaborative SLAM
SMPC-based inter-agent loop closure candidate detection
real-time validation across visual and LiDAR descriptors

papers.title: Disturbance-aware Motion Planning for Over-actuated Underwater Vehicles Exploiting Actuation Redundancy for High-fidelity 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Yuer Gao, Tongqing Xu, Qingyang Liu, Yi Cai
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇把水下机器人推进器扰动与视觉重建质量直接耦合起来，而不是只优化跟踪和稳定性。对于八推进器 ROV，同一运动可以由多种推力分配实现，作者在冗余空间中搜索能最小化目标区域扰动的分配。其 thruster-wake proxy 与实时 allocator 在实验中降低颗粒速度并显著改善 3D reconstruction RMSE。它是 Physical AI 里很好的例子：控制策略要考虑自己对感知输入质量的物理影响。
methodHighlights: real-time disturbance minimization improving reconstruction RMSE

papers.title: Geometric Collapse: When Vision Models Fail to Verify Physical Causality
papers.authors: Wentao Zhang, Jinhu Qi, Weiqiang Jin, Yifei Zhang, Chan-Tong Lam, Irwin King
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Geometric Collapse 用 Scrambled Edges 这个受控反事实来测试 dense geometric predictors 是否能拒绝物理上不成立的边缘证据。实验显示 CNN/ViT/SSL 深度预测器会受到远超能量匹配噪声的扰动，错误还会传播到 mask 外区域。即便给 oracle corrupted region，输出级修复也只能恢复部分错误。它对三维视觉基础模型的提醒是：几何预测器需要显式 plausibility scoring 和 cue quarantine，而不是只扩大预训练规模。
methodHighlights: Scrambled Edges counterfactual for physically unsupported geometry cues
controlled tests on dense depth predictors across NYU Depth v2 and KITTI
evidence of global error propagation and limited output-level repair

papers.title: CaLiSym: Learning Symplectic Dynamics of Real-World Systems through Structured Canonical Lifts
papers.authors: Aristotelis Papatheodorou, Pranav Vaidhyanathan, Natalia Ares, Ioannis Havoutis, Gerard J. Milburn
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.LG
papers.summary: CaLiSym 把精确 symplectic learning 扩展到带驱动、耗散和约束的真实机器人系统。它不在测量状态上直接强加 symplecticity，而是把状态和物理端口嵌入结构化 lifted canonical phase space，在那里学习精确辛映射。框架不需要 recurrent latent、transformer decoder、隐式优化或推理时 ODE integration。对 physics-aware AI 来说，这篇提供了把几何守恒先验带进接触丰富机器人动力学预测的一种轻量方式。
methodHighlights: structured canonical lifts for driven, dissipative and constrained systems
exact symplectic maps in lifted phase space
out-of-distribution autoregressive prediction on pendulum, quadrotor and quadruped systems

papers.title: Flow-ERD: Agent-type Aware Flow Matching with Entropy-Regularized Distillation for Diverse Traffic Simulation
papers.authors: Seulbin Hwang, Kiyoung Om, Daejung Kim, Jinhan Lee
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 8 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-09 (Thursday, 9 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.LG
papers.summary: Flow-ERD 面向自动驾驶交通仿真中的 realism-diversity tradeoff，避免只优化逼真度导致模式坍缩。它用 Agent-Type Aware Flow Matching 结合多模态表达能力和不同交通主体的运动执行约束，再用 entropy-regularized reverse-KL 蒸馏降低闭环 rollout 的分布偏移。论文用 log-free diversity metric 和标准 realism 指标一起评估，并报告在 WOSAC test benchmark 上表现突出。对闭环驾驶仿真，这篇强调多样性本身应成为优化目标。
methodHighlights: agent-type aware flow matching for multi-agent traffic simulation
entropy-regularized distillation to reduce covariate shift without mode collapse
joint realism-diversity evaluation for autonomous driving simulation

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-08
reports.summary: 2026-07-08 官方 arXiv 批次主体 32 篇，聚焦 4D world model/VLA、3D 场景理解与生成、3DGS/SLAM、HOI 和 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天最强的信号是 world model 与 VLA 开始向 4D/3D 物理表征靠拢：RynnWorld-4D、Lift3D-VLA、MECo-WAM、RynnWorld-Teleop 都在把几何、动作和未来预测绑定起来，而不是只做视觉上合理的视频生成。
实时/交互式 world model 也明显升温：MoWorld 强调低成本高帧率部署，AlayaWorld 强调可游玩的长时交互世界，Image2Sim 则把 RGB-D 扫描变成具身导航模拟器。它们共同指向一个趋势：world model 正在变成机器人和仿真的运行时组件。
三维场景理解从单房间、单任务走向长期和层级空间记忆：GEM-Occ 做 embodied semantic occupancy memory，CAIRN 做跨房间 topology-aware 3D-LLM，TRIG 和 Hilti-Trimble-Oxford 则分别强化自动驾驶/施工场景的度量几何和视觉惯性定位。
3DGS 的重心继续从“渲染质量”扩展到鲁棒性、语义和不确定性：SSA-3DGS 处理真实采集伪影，Bayesian 3DGS 提供 uncertainty/复杂度控制，GaussFusion 尝试把 Gaussian 表示预训练成多模态 3D token。
HOI 和 Physical AI 侧，SparseCtrl-HOI、WristMimic、ThorArena、LAMP 把注意力放在手-物接触、力、稀疏控制和人形机器人交互上；这说明三维视觉日报需要继续把 HOI 与普通 HCI 区分开，今天的 cs.HC 交叉条目只在与 world model/具身交互强相关时纳入。

papers.title: RynnWorld-4D: 4D Embodied World Models for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Haoyu Zhao, Xingyue Zhao, Siteng Huang, Xin Li, Deli Zhao, Zhongyu Li
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: RynnWorld-4D 把机器人 world model 的表示从 2D 视频提升到同步 RGB、depth 和 optical flow 组成的 RGB-DF 4D 动态空间。论文的核心判断是，几何结构与时间运动需要一起预测，才更接近末端执行器动作所需的物理状态。方法通过 4D embodied world model 生成动作条件下的未来多模态观测，并将世界预测与策略学习之间的接口做得更低层、更具物理含义。对机器人操作而言，它值得优先看，因为它直接回答“世界模型预测什么表示才对控制有用”。
methodHighlights: robot manipulation policy learning from physically grounded futures

papers.title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
papers.authors: Jiaming Liu, Qingpo Wuwu, Nuowei Han, Hao Chen, Zhuoyang Liu, Fan Fei, Yueru Jia, Chenyang Gu, Yandong Guo, Boxin Shi, Shanghang Zhang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: Lift3D-VLA 针对现有 VLA 在三维几何和动态动作建模上的短板，显式把点云推理接入视觉-语言-动作模型。它强调物理环境中的操作泛化不能只靠 2D 图像 token，需要同时保留 3D 结构、空间关系和时间一致动作。论文报告覆盖 22 个仿真任务和 8 个真实任务，重点在“2D VLA 如何被提升到几何/动力学感知”的工程路径。对做 VLA 与三维感知融合的人，这篇是今日最直接相关的系统论文之一。
methodHighlights: explicit 3D point-cloud reasoning for VLA models

papers.title: Learning 4D Geometric Priors for Inference-Efficient World Action Models
papers.authors: Jianjun Zhang, Jian Zhu, Taiyi Su, Chong Ma, Zitai Huang, Yi Xu, Hanli Wang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI
papers.summary: 这篇提出 MECo-WAM，目标是在不显著增加推理成本的前提下，把动作相关的 4D 几何先验注入 World Action Model。作者认为现有 video-action co-training 容易学习外观 latent，而不是抓取、推动、接触等任务真正需要的时变几何。训练阶段引入视频专家、动作专家和轻量 4D 专家，推理阶段仍保持轻量图结构。它的价值在于把“几何监督只在训练时出现”作为一种实用的 Physical AI 设计。
methodHighlights: 4D geometric expert supervised by relational targets
geometry-enhanced training with lightweight inference graph

papers.title: RynnWorld-Teleop: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Digital Teleoperation
papers.authors: Haoyu Zhao, Xingyue Zhao, Hangyu Li, Biao Gong, Kehan Li, Siteng Huang, Xin Li, Deli Zhao, Zhongyu Li
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: RynnWorld-Teleop 把遥操作数据采集从真实机器人上解耦出来，让操作者用手部姿态流驱动生成式机器人中心 world model。模型从单张参考图合成高保真第一视角视频，同时记录可迁移到目标机器人的 pose/action 标签。这个设定把 world model 变成“数字遥操作环境”，用于缓解真实硬件、工作空间和人力时间的瓶颈。它和 RynnWorld-4D 形成互补：一篇强调 4D 状态表示，一篇强调数据规模化机制。
methodHighlights: digital teleoperation driven by hand-pose streams
embodiment-agnostic action labels for robot retargeting

papers.title: Image2Sim: Scaling Embodied Navigation via Generative Neural Simulator
papers.authors: Zihan Wang, Seungjun Lee, Yinghao Xu, Gim Hee Lee
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: Image2Sim 面向具身导航的可扩展仿真环境问题，用 posed RGB-D 序列构建实时神经模拟器。它把 3D 空间锚定与 photorealistic observation synthesis 解耦，在保留真实扫描视觉质量的同时获得可交互环境。相比传统合成仿真，它更关注 sim-to-real 和物理锚定；相比真实扫描数据，它更强调可扩展和可 rollout。对导航、具身评测和世界模型训练数据构建都很有参考价值。
methodHighlights: real-time neural simulator from posed RGB-D sequences
decoupled 3D spatial anchoring and observation synthesis

papers.title: MoWorld: A Flash World Model
papers.authors: Team Moxin, Deyi Ji, Tianrun Chen, Xin Zhang, Jiale Yang, Qi Zhu, An Zhao, Zihao Xie, Han Wang, Xuanyi Liu, Yixiang Zhou, Pei Liu, Yi Tan, Cheng Chen, Dayi Zhu, Mingyu Wei, Hanjie Xu, Jun Liao, Siqi Li, Lingyu Lu, Hongye Fang, Hongming Tan, Youjiang Zhu, Taiyu Zhang, Zejian Li, Chaotao Ding, Lanyun Zhu, Yunhe Pan, Lingyun Sun
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: MoWorld 把 world model 的关注点从单纯能力扩展到实时交互成本，目标是在 NPU 等低成本设备上达到高帧率。论文强调其训练数据来自 3D-native 数据引擎，覆盖真实与合成环境，并以几何一致性和轨迹质量筛选数据。方法链路包括数据生成、预训练、蒸馏和混合精度并行推理，宣称可达到 50 FPS 交互。项目页显示代码和体验仍是 Coming Soon，因此目前更适合作为系统路线参考。
methodHighlights: Flash World Model for real-time interaction
3D-native data engine with geometric consistency filtering
distillation and mixed-precision deployment for low-cost inference

papers.title: AlayaWorld: Long-Horizon and Playable Video World Generation
papers.authors: AlayaWorld Team, Kaipeng Zhang, Chuanhao Li, Yifan Zhan, Yongtao Ge, Yuanyang Yin, Jiaming Tan, Kang He, Liaoyuan Fan, Ruicong Liu, Xiaojie Xu, Xuangeng Chu, Zhen Li, Zhengyuan Lin, Zhixiang Wang, Zian Meng, Zihui Gao
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.HC
papers.summary: AlayaWorld 讨论从视频 world model 构建可长时交互、可游玩的生成式世界。它把游戏录像和真实视频作为训练来源，让模型根据当前世界状态和用户动作自回归生成后续观测。论文的重点不是传统三维重建，而是把可控视频生成、实时交互和虚拟环境开发打通。它对具身智能的启发在于，world model 可以成为在线环境生成器，而不仅是离线预测器。
methodHighlights: full-stack framework for interactive generative worlds

papers.title: GEM-Occ: From Visual Geometry Evidence to Embodied Semantic Occupancy Memory
papers.authors: Hu Zhu, Bohan Li, Xianda Guo, Hongsi Liu, Baorui Peng, Mingqi Yuan, Xin Jin, Wenjun Zeng, Chang Wen Chen
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: GEM-Occ 针对室内具身智能的长期空间记忆，构建层级化语义占用表示和 HIOcc benchmark。它把 ScanNet、ScanNet++、Matterport3D 统一为稀疏语义占用格式，同时保留 perspective RGB-D 与 pano-centric 观测几何。方法强调从视觉几何证据形成可持续更新的 embodied semantic occupancy memory，而不是只做单帧占用预测。对三维场景理解、导航和机器人长期记忆都值得优先阅读。
methodHighlights: unified sparse occupancy format across indoor datasets
embodied spatial memory from visual geometry evidence

papers.title: CAIRN: Cross-Room 3D Scene Understanding with Topology-Aware Large Multimodal Models
papers.authors: He Liang, Chenyang Ma, Yiming Zhang, Sangyun Shin, Andrew Markham, Niki Trigoni, Yuhang He
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: CAIRN 面向真实家庭中的跨房间 3D 场景理解，指出现有 3D-LLM 多停留在单房间、简化对象集合上。它让 transformer attention 显式对齐对象级关系、房间级抽象和房间连通拓扑，并通过几何偏置的层级 attention mask 控制信息路由。作者还构建 CAIRN-MR benchmark，覆盖 grounding、captioning 和跨房间问答。arXiv 给出项目页，但本轮抓取该 GitHub Pages 地址返回 Site not found，需要后续复核。
methodHighlights: object relation GNN and learned room tokens

papers.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
papers.authors: Tianjiao Yu, Xinzhuo Li, Yifan Shen, Onkar Susladkar, Yuanzhe Liu, Xiaona Zhou, Ismini Lourentzou
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.AI, cs.LG
papers.summary: ELSA3D 试图把 3D 生成与 3D 语言理解统一到同一 backbone 中，核心问题是文本和三维几何 token 的交互不能只是平铺自注意力。它提出 elastic semantic anchoring，用 scale-aware octree tokenizer 表示几何，再用 Anchor Tokens 在合适的三维尺度上检索和写回语义证据。模型同时面向 image-to-3D、text-to-3D 和 3D captioning，并强调更低 FLOPs 与更快推理。它是今日三维生成/理解统一方向的重点论文。
methodHighlights: elastic semantic anchoring between language and geometry

papers.title: SSA-3DGS: Unsupervised Removal of Screen-Space Artifacts for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Kristof Overdulve, Lode Jorissen, Nick Michiels
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.GR, cs.CV
papers.summary: SSA-3DGS 处理真实采集中常见但容易被 3DGS 烘进几何的 screen-space artifacts，例如水印、镜头污点、遮挡和传感器缺陷。论文把这些固定在二维图像平面的伪影与真实三维结构区分开，通过无监督方式减轻 floaters 和近相机错误高斯。它的应用场景很实际：真实数据越脏，3DGS 越需要这种 artifact-aware 训练。对把 3DGS 用到车载、户外和消费级采集的人优先级较高。
methodHighlights: robust novel-view synthesis from imperfect captures

papers.title: Rendering-Aware Bayesian 3D Gaussian Splatting with Native Uncertainty and Adaptive Complexity Control
papers.authors: Gaoxiang Jia, Vikram Appia, Junzhou Huang, Xinlei Wang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.AI
papers.summary: 这篇把 Bayesian uncertainty 引入 3DGS，用渲染器派生的统计量跟踪高斯均值和协方差后验。目标是在 sparse-view 或固定采集预算下，知道哪些几何区域证据不足、哪些视角更值得补采。可选的 Dirichlet-process 扩展提供组件使用信号，用于复杂度控制。它的启发是，3DGS 系统化应用需要从“拟合快”走向“知道自己哪里不确定”。
methodHighlights: adaptive complexity control and informative-view selection

papers.title: GaussFusion: Towards Multimodal 3D Gaussian Pretraining
papers.authors: Zhixuan You, Jihua Zhu, Yiding Sun, Zihao Guo, Haozhe Cheng, Dongxu Zhang, Lin Chen, Hainan Luo
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: GaussFusion 把 3D Gaussian 表示当作可预训练的显式 3D foundation representation。相比只做 masked Gaussian reconstruction，它引入图像和文本监督，通过跨模态语义对齐让 Gaussian encoder 同时学习局部结构和语言级语义。这个方向很关键，因为 3DGS 正从渲染表示转向可被检测、理解、检索和生成模型复用的通用 3D token。它适合关注 3D 表征预训练的人优先阅读。
methodHighlights: masked Gaussian modeling with image-text alignment
semantic Gaussian encoder for downstream 3D tasks

papers.title: APVI-SLAM: Real-Time Acoustic-Pressure-Visual-Inertial Localization and Photorealistic Mapping System in Complex Underwater Environment
papers.authors: Hanwen Zhang, Yipeng Zhu, Xiaopeng Guo, Huajian Huang, Sai-Kit Yeung
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: APVI-SLAM 面向水下极端环境中的视觉退化和定位漂移，融合 acoustic、pressure、visual 与 inertial 传感器。系统用 reliability-aware localization 动态重权不同估计器，并通过 sliding-window freezing 从视觉跟踪失败中恢复。论文同时强调 photorealistic mapping，这使它不仅是定位系统，也与三维重建/神经渲染式地图表示有关。对水下机器人和弱视觉条件 SLAM 有实用价值。

papers.title: Hilti-Trimble-Oxford Dataset: 360 Visual-Inertial Benchmark with Floor Plan Priors for SLAM and Localization
papers.authors: Samuele Centanni, Yuhao Zhang, Yifu Tao, Julien Kindle, Frank Neuhaus, Tilman Koß, Aryaman Patel, Michael Helmberger, Emilia Szymańska, Torben Gräber, Maurice Fallon
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: Hilti-Trimble-Oxford Dataset 提供面向施工现场的 360 visual-inertial SLAM 与 floor-plan-referenced localization benchmark。它关注低成本 360 相机与 IMU 在建筑进度监测中的定位和三维地图构建能力，而不是依赖昂贵 LiDAR。题名中出现 Oxford，但本轮未发现它与 Oxford VGG/Visual Geometry Group 有直接关系；它入选是因为 SLAM/定位数据集本身强相关。对视觉惯性定位和建筑场景 mapping 研究很有用。

papers.title: TRIG: Trajectory-Rig Decoupled Metric Geometry Learning
papers.authors: Lizhou Liao, Wentao Xu, Handong Wang, Lirong Yang, Shuai Yang, Weiwei Liu, Chang Huang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: TRIG 针对自动驾驶多相机系统中的 metric geometry 学习，把时变 ego trajectory 与静态 camera-rig geometry 解耦。现有视觉几何模型常把相机位姿编码为纠缠表示，难以利用车端刚性相机架的先验。TRIG 的价值在于把车辆多相机 rig 当作结构化几何对象，而不是普通多视角输入。对自动驾驶中的深度、位姿和 3D 重建联合学习很值得关注。
methodHighlights: metric depth, pose and 3D reconstruction learning
vehicle-side geometric priors for autonomous driving

papers.title: SparseCtrl-HOI: Sparse Temporal Control for Human-Object Interaction Video Generation
papers.authors: Shenbo Xie, Mingrui Cai, Xu Yang, Yifei Liu, Changxing Ding
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: SparseCtrl-HOI 研究 human-object interaction 视频生成，重点是用稀疏时间控制替代逐帧手-物姿态监督。论文指出 HOI 的难点在于手、物体和接触动态的细粒度时空协调，密集控制会带来高标注成本并限制动作多样性。SparseCtrl-HOI 试图只给关键时间点或稀疏控制信号，也能生成连贯的操作过程。它属于今日 HOI/手物交互方向最明确的条目。
methodHighlights: sparse temporal control for HOI video generation
reduced dependence on frame-wise hand-object pose guidance

papers.title: WristMimic: Full-Body Humanoid Control with Wrist-Guided Manipulation
papers.authors: Wongyun Yu, Youngwoon Kim, Minsu Cho
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV, cs.GR
papers.summary: WristMimic 关注如何把 human-object interaction demonstrations 迁移到物理仿真中的全身人形控制。它将无接触身体/腕部运动与接触丰富的手指操作分离：身体和手腕跟踪运动目标，手指则学习抓取和接触行为，而不是硬跟踪人手姿态。这个设计避免了直接监督手指导致的接触过约束。对从人类演示学习机器人操作、尤其是人形机器人手物交互，很有启发。
methodHighlights: separation of contact-free body motion and contact-rich finger behavior
retargeting HOI demonstrations to physics simulation

papers.title: ThorArena: Benchmarking Humanoid Physical Interaction with Human Motion-Force Demonstrations
papers.authors: Chenhao Yu, Hongwu Wang, Weitao Zhang, Youhao Hu, Jiachen Zhang, Gangyang Li, Alois Knoll, Shaqi Luo
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: ThorArena 提供一个用于评估人形机器人接触丰富物理交互的 benchmark，重点是同步 human motion-force demonstrations。作者指出现有 humanoid imitation 多评估运动学跟踪，却忽略外力、接触和稳定性。ThorArena 让评测可以覆盖 force-aware tracking、稳定控制和真实物理交互鲁棒性。它不属于传统三维视觉论文，但对 Physical AI 和人形机器人 benchmark 很相关。

papers.title: GraspIT: A Dataset Bridging the Sim-to-Real gap and back for Validated Grasping SE(3) Pose Generation
papers.authors: Paul Koch. Adem Karakurt, André Sers
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: GraspIT 提供一个连接仿真与真实抓取的 RGB-D 数据集和 SE(3) 抓取姿态生成设置。它在 Isaac Sim 中对约 230 万候选抓取做物理 slip-test，保留连续质量分数和 force-closure 通过但物理失败的 hard negatives。论文的重点是让抓取数据既有 photorealistic observation，又有经过物理验证的可执行性。arXiv comment 写明 release soon，因此当前代码/数据还未明确开放。
methodHighlights: hard negatives for SE(3) grasp pose generation

papers.title: FORGE: Towards Functional Tool-Use Generalization via Keypoint Trajectory Reasoning
papers.authors: Chuhao Zhou, Liquan Wang, Shuxin Cao, Xiangyu Chen, Yuxuan Hu, Boyu Ma, Animesh Garg, Jianfei Yang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CV
papers.summary: FORGE 研究工具使用的功能泛化：不同工具外观可能共享功能意图，但动作空间完全不同。论文比较 affordance image、人类视频提示和 2D keypoint trajectory，认为关键点轨迹更能连接功能语义与可执行动作。方法把工具功能抽象成可推理的轨迹表示，再用于 novel tool 的操作泛化。它对机器人从视觉功能理解走向动作生成很有参考价值。
methodHighlights: keypoint trajectory reasoning as intermediate representation
bridging visual function and executable actions

papers.title: LAMP: Latent Motion Prior-Guided Real-World Learning for Dexterous Hand Manipulation
papers.authors: Xinye Yang, Zhiyuan Ma, Hongze Yu, Yuanpei Chen, Yaodong Yang, Xiaojie Chai, Xinlei Chen, Chao Yu
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: LAMP 关注真实灵巧手学习中的高维动作探索问题，用 latent motion prior 约束动作空间。该 prior 从近期手部动作历史映射到紧凑 latent，再解码成高维手目标，减少接触破坏和无效探索。方法结合 imitation learning 与在线 reinforcement learning，面向真实硬件上的 dexterous manipulation。它没有显式三维重建贡献，但对手物交互和 Physical AI 操作学习有价值。
methodHighlights: safe exploration for high-dimensional dexterous hands

papers.title: UniLM-Nav: A Unified Framework for Zero-Shot Last-Mile Navigation
papers.authors: Zhuofan Zhang, Tianxu Wang, Guoxi Zhang, Yixiong Lin, Xilin Wang, Hongming Xu, Qing Li, Song-Chun Zhu, Lifeng Fan
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: UniLM-Nav 处理 mobile manipulation 中的 last-mile navigation：到达目标附近不等于拥有可操作的基座位姿。方法把问题拆成视角选择、任务条件 affordance grounding 和几何感知 base-pose reasoning。它强调 zero-shot、open-vocabulary 和细粒度空间约束，比普通导航更接近三维操作准备。对把导航和操作接口接起来的机器人系统值得关注。
methodHighlights: geometry-aware base-pose reasoning for mobile manipulation

papers.title: RoboTALES: Learning Reasoning-Guided Robot Policies via Task-Aligned Simulated Futures
papers.authors: Hanan Gani, Tejal Kulkarni, Madhoolika Chodavarapu, Nicklas Hansen, Manmohan Chandraker
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: RoboTALES 用任务对齐的 simulated futures 来训练机器人策略，试图修正预训练视频生成模型想象未来时偏离任务的问题。它用 LLM planner 分解复杂任务，再用 VLM critic 评价生成的未来并提供奖励反馈。方法本质上把生成式视频模型变成可被任务语义约束的 policy training source。对 world model 如何服务机器人策略，而不是只生成好看视频，有直接启发。

papers.title: Imagined Rollouts are Kinematic, Not Dynamic: A Diagnosis of Long-Horizon World-Model Failure
papers.authors: Finn Rasmus Schäfer, Korbinian Moller, Yuan Gao, Christian Oefinger, Sebastian Schmidt, Johannes Betz
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇 workshop paper 诊断长时域 world model 失败，认为问题不只是 compounding error，而是模型更像在“运动学想象”而非“动力学想象”。作者提出 imagined Kinematic-Consistency Error，用闭式运动学 null 来衡量 rollout 偏离，并用扰动协议检查物理条件跨越 regime boundary 时诊断是否响应。虽然实验集中在 DreamerV3 和 DMC walker-walk，但观点对机器人 world model 很重要。它提醒后续评测必须区分视觉连贯、运动学一致和真实动力学可行。
methodHighlights: perturbation protocol for physical regime boundaries

papers.title: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models
papers.authors: Xinyuan Chen, Haoyu Guo, Shi Guo, Bingqi Jiang, Chunhua Shen, Xing Shen, Tianfan Xue, Yufei Xue, Mulin Yu, Weinan Zhang, Bin Zhao, Bowen Zhou, Ming Zhou

papers.summary: A Definition and Roadmap for World Models 是一篇 58 页 technical report，试图统一 world model 的定义、技术维度和发展阶段。它覆盖 model-based RL、视频生成、具身机器人和 Physical AI，重点是澄清 world model 应预测什么、如何构建、如何评估。虽然不是三维视觉方法论文，但在今天 world model 条目高度密集的背景下很适合作为框架性读物。建议作为背景材料阅读，而不是替代具体系统论文。

papers.title: Harnessing Generative Image Models for Training-Free Primitive Shape Abstraction
papers.authors: Gregor Kobsik, Tim Elsner, Leif Kobbelt

papers.summary: 这篇研究如何不训练模型，直接利用生成式图像模型做 3D shape 的 primitive abstraction。流程从 3D 物体渲染多视图图像，利用视觉语言模型分析语义部件，再回到几何 primitive 表示。它把大规模图像模型的 part reasoning 能力迁移到三维形状抽象，适合机器人、仿真和场景理解中的紧凑几何表示。相比端到端 3D 网络，它更像一种训练免费、模型外接式几何管线。

papers.title: NegROI: Click-Centric Uncertainty-Guided Refinement with Scene-Conditioned Negative Prompts for Robust Interactive 3D Segmentation
papers.authors: Shuheng Zhang, Feng Wu

papers.title: Point as Skeleton: Accumulated Point Cloud Enhanced Autoregressive Generation for Closed-Loop Autonomous Driving Simulation
papers.authors: Songbur Wong, Xiaosong Jia, Junqi You, Bo Zhang, Pei Xu, Renqiu Xia, Yuping Qiu, Shaofeng Zhang, Zelin Zhao, Xuechao Yan, Yuchen Zhou, Yurui Chen, Wen Guo, Hang Xu, Junchi Yan

papers.title: SIEVE: Structure-Aware Data Selection for Imitation Learning with VLA Models
papers.authors: Changti Wu, Bin Yu, Zhaolong Shen, Shijie Lian, Xiaopeng Lin, Cong Huang, Zhirui Zhang, Lei Zhang, Kai Chen

papers.title: From Foundation to Application: Improving VLA Models in Practice
papers.authors: Wei Wu, Fangjing Wang, Fan Lu, He Sun, Shi Liu, Yunnan Wang, Yibin Yan, Yong Wang, Shuailei Ma, Xinyang Wang, Yibin Liu, Shuai Yang, Tianxiang Zhou, Kejia Zhang, Lei Zhou, Cheng Su, Nan Xue, Bin Tan, Han Zhang, Youchao Zhang, Fei Liao, Xing Zhu, Yujun Shen, Kecheng Zheng
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 7 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-08 (Wednesday, 8 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: LingBot-VLA 2.0 是偏系统和应用落地的 VLA 技术报告，强调跨任务、跨 embodiment 和真实部署。它使用约 60,000 小时数据，包括 50,000 小时机器人轨迹和 10,000 小时 egocentric human videos，并扩展到双臂和灵巧操作。报告还给出网站、GitHub 和 Hugging Face 资源，便于跟踪复现进展。对研究平台化 VLA 和产业级 Physical AI 数据管线有参考意义。

papers.title: OrchardBench: A Physically-Grounded, GPU-Parallel Apple-Orchard Simulation Benchmark for Agricultural Robotics

papers.summary: OrchardBench 构建 physically grounded、GPU-parallel 的苹果园仿真 benchmark，目标是服务农业机器人采摘研究。每棵树由随机 L-system 生长，并作为 fully articulated body 实例化，弥合图形学树模型“几何细但无物理”和机器人仿真“可并行但树不真实”的缺口。它虽然不是常规三维视觉论文，但涉及 articulated natural objects、物理仿真和机器人操作评测。对 Physical AI 仿真环境设计有启发。
