reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-07
reports.summary: 2026-07-07 官方 arXiv 批次主体 32 篇，聚焦 world model/VLA、3DGS、场景级 3D 生成与 Physical AI；补充 0 篇。
trends: 今天的最大密度在机器人 world model/VLA：GigaWorld-1、Worldscape-MoE、DynaWM、DREAMSTEER、TACO、KAM-WM、WSA1 都在回答同一个问题，即世界模型怎样从“会生成未来”变成“能评估、能纠偏、能驱动动作”。
Physical AI 的触觉和可变形物体线索明显升温：Deform360 给出大规模多视角触觉数据，TACO 把触觉 world model 用于 VLA post-training，Mask2Real-WM 用 mask dynamics 缩小灵巧手 sim-to-real gap。
3DGS 继续系统化：今天既有 VOP-GS、DP-GS、LiDAR-GS SLAM、PRISM3D 这类几何/建图强化，也有 GUSH3R、WildSplat、AdaptiveSplat、CGGS、DeGenseGS 这类前馈、动态、语义和生成式扩展。
三维生成从单资产走向场景级和 4D：SynCity 3000、SceneFrom3D、InSpace、MV-Forcing 分别覆盖 scene-scale diffusion、户外几何条件生成、室内结构化生成和长时多视角动态视频。
值得注意的是，今天没有把普通 HCI 纳入 HOI；入选条目均与三维视觉、具身交互、机器人或 Physical AI 有直接关联。

papers.title: Deform360: A Massive Multi-view Visuotactile Dataset for Deformable World Models
papers.authors: Hongyu Li, Wanjia Fu, Xiaoyan Cong, Zekun Li, Binghao Huang, Hanxiao Jiang, Xintong He, Yiqing Liang, Rao Fu, Tao Lu, Srinath Sridhar, Kevin A. Smith, George Konidaris, Yunzhu Li
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-07 (Tuesday, 7 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: Deform360 直击可变形物体 world model 的数据短板：它用 41 个环绕视角相机和双手触觉夹爪记录 198 个日常物体、1,980 段交互和超过 215 小时观测。论文还提供 markerless visuotactile 3D tracking pipeline，把局部接触形变和全局几何运动对齐到密集 3D 表示。它特别适合比较 2D 视频世界模型与 3D 粒子/几何世界模型的边界，也能直接支持可变形物体的机器人规划评测。
methodHighlights: large-scale multi-view visuotactile dataset for deformable objects
markerless 3D tracking for dense geometry and motion
benchmark comparing 2D video world models and 3D particle models

papers.title: GigaWorld-1: A Roadmap to Build World Models for Robot Policy Evaluation
papers.authors: GigaWorld Team, Angyuan Ma, Boyuan Wang, Bohan Li, Chaojun Ni, Guo Li, Guan Huang, Guosheng Zhao, Hao Li, Hengtao Li, Jingyu Liu, Jiwen Lu, Qiuping Deng, Tingdong Yu, Xuancheng Xu, Xinyu Zhou, Xiuwei Xu, Xinze Chen, Xiaofeng Wang, Xiaoyu Tian, Yang Wang, Yifan Chang, Yukun Zhou, Yun Ye, Zhenyu Wu, Zhanqian Wu, Zheng Zhu
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 2 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-07 (Tuesday, 7 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: GigaWorld-1 把 world model 从“生成未来画面”推向“评估机器人策略”的基础设施。论文构建 WMBench，将真实遥操作数据、匹配的策略 rollout、动作编码和长时域评估统一起来，分析 7 类视频世界模型和 4 种动作表示。核心结论很清楚：视觉真实感不是最关键，长时域动作一致性、动作编码、记忆设计和面向评估的后训练更决定是否能替代真实 rollout。
methodHighlights: WMBench for world-model-based robot policy evaluation
324k+ simulated rollouts paired with real robot executions

papers.title: Worldscape-MoE: A Unified Mixture-of-Experts World Model for Scalable Heterogeneous Action Control
papers.authors: Jianjie Fang, Yongyan Xu, Ziyou Wang, Chen Gao, Yuchao Huang, Zhaolu Wang, Rongze Tang, Mingyuan Jia, Baining Zhao, Weichen Zhang, Xin Zhang, Haisheng Su, Yu Shang, Wei Wu, Xinlei Chen, Yong Li
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 4 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-07 (Tuesday, 7 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI
papers.summary: Worldscape-MoE 关注一个很现实的扩展问题：不同 world model 控制接口被割裂成相机轨迹、机器人动作、手部关节等孤立形式。它把这些异构控制看作对同一物理世界的不同约束，用 Diffusion Transformer 加 MoE 来共享世界动力学，同时保留控制专属专家。实验覆盖 locomotion、机器人操作和 egocentric hand control，强调异构监督可以互相增强而不是互相干扰。
methodHighlights: modality-aware control injection for heterogeneous actions
progressive MoE tuning for extending new control modalities

papers.title: From Fixed to Free Cameras: Calibration-Free View-Robust Vision-Language-Action Model
papers.authors: Wenhao Li, Xueying Jiang, Quanhao Qian, Deli Zhao, Shijian Lu, Gongjie Zhang, Ran Xu
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 6 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-07 (Tuesday, 7 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV, cs.AI, cs.LG, cs.RO
papers.summary: CamVLA 针对真实部署中相机被移动、重装、外参不可用的问题。它让策略同时预测相机坐标系下的末端动作和 6-DoF hand-eye 矩阵，再用几何变换合成机器人基坐标动作。这个设计把“如何动”和“从哪里看”解耦，对只用单目 RGB、无深度、无标定的 VLA 部署很有参考价值。

papers.title: DynaWM: A Base-VLA-Guided World Foundation Model for Moving-Object Manipulation
papers.authors: Chongkei Chang, Zhidong Deng

papers.summary: DynaWM 面向动态移动物体操作，避免把 world model 直接塞进 base VLA 后破坏原模型能力。它把 base VLA 输出的 action chunk、V-JEPA 2.1 多视角视觉历史和机器人本体状态共同条件化到 flow-matching DiT，重新生成 motion-aware 动作轨迹。论文还构建 DynaGrasp-32 和 DynaGrasp-1600，用于系统评估速度变化、轨迹变化和多目标动态抓取。

papers.title: Mask2Real-WM: Segmentation Masks as a Sim-to-Real Bridge for Controllable Dexterous World Models
papers.authors: Riccardo O. Feingold, Davide Liconti, Chenyu Yang, Robert K. Katzschmann

papers.summary: Mask2Real-WM 把灵巧手 world model 拆成 mask-space dynamics 和 RGB rendering 两阶段，利用分割空间更小的 sim-to-real gap。动力学模型预测 23-DoF 动作序列下的未来 mask，渲染模型再用 ControlNet-augmented SVD 生成真实感视频。结果显示 mask 条件和仿真预训练对细粒度每关节可控性都必要，这对 dexterous manipulation 的数据扩展尤其有用。

papers.title: DREAMSTEER: Latent World Models Can Steer VLA Policies During Deployment Without Any Finetuning
papers.authors: Hanchen Cui, Sergio Arnaud, Arjun Majumdar, Daniel Dugas, Elie Aljalbout, Karthik Desingh, Krishna Murthy Jatavallabhula, Franziska Meier
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 3 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-07 (Tuesday, 7 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: DREAMSTEER 研究不微调 VLA 的部署期纠偏：从 VLA 和预定义运动 primitive 采样候选动作，用 latent world model 想象结果，再由语言条件 value model 排序。它把 world model 用作 test-time steering 模块，而不是训练时辅助损失。真实机器人实验中，任务成功率从 23.75% 提升到 66.25%，说明“想象-筛选”对分布偏移很有杀伤力。
methodHighlights: latent world model rollout plus language-conditioned value ranking
candidate action chunks from VLA and motion primitives

papers.title: TACO: TActile World Model as a Self-COrrector forScalable VLA Post-Training
papers.authors: Shengbang Liu, Yueru Jia, Yuyang Yan, Jiaming Liu, Xinran Zhang, Qiuxuan Feng, Yandong Guo, Shiji Zhou, Boxin Shi, Shanghang Zhang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 3 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-07 (Tuesday, 7 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: TACO 认为接触丰富操作失败通常是局部接触误差，视觉上很难提前发现。它用 tactile-aware world model 形成 Recognize-Imagine-Label 循环：识别接近失败的状态、想象局部触觉修正片段、再给出可执行纠偏动作。对手-物接触和 Physical AI 的启发是，触觉不是附加传感器，而是可扩展生成纠错数据的监督源。
methodHighlights: knowledge-insulated tactile adaptation with advantage-conditioned training

papers.title: WSA$_1$: a 3D-Centric World-Spatial-Action Model for Generalizable Robot Control
papers.authors: Jiahao Jiang, Jianing Zhang, Zhenhan Yin, Ruidong Chen, Sen Wang, Zhaoshu Yu, Pengpeng Zeng, Xiaofeng Cao, Xuanhan Wang, Jingkuan Song, Heng Tao Shen

data-efficient pretraining for generalizable robot control

papers.title: KAM-WM: Kinematic Affordance Maps from Latent World Models for Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Xinyu Shao, Keru Zhou, Guowei Huang, Yajun Gao, Tongtong Cao, Xiu Li

papers.title: ACE-Brain-0.5: A Unified Embodied Foundational Model for Physical Agentic AI
papers.authors: ACE-Brain Team: Ziyang Gong, Haoming Gu, Zehang Luo, Tianyi Zhang, Tao Tao, Yixiao Chi, Zhe Liu, Lingsi Zhu, Jingyuan Liu, Anke Tang, Songze Li, Yilun Kong, Ningjing Liu, Tianyu Zhu, Yunpeng Qing, Shuang Luo, Xiang Liu, Shi Fu, Dawei Nie, Sixiang Liu, Zhexi Wen, Feng Pan, Xiaofeng Wang, Zhi Hou, Chunxiao Liu, Xue Yang, Junchi Yan, Hengshuang Zhao, Dacheng Tao, Xiaogang Wang

papers.title: WildSplat: Feedforward Gaussian Splatting from Unposed In-the-Wild Images

papers.title: InSpace: Structure-Aware 3D Indoor Scene Generation from a Single 360° Image

papers.title: PRISM3D: Probabilistic Refinement and Robust Initialization for Physically Consistent Scene Modeling under Extreme Motion Blur

papers.title: PhysMirror: Physics-Aware Mirror Object Generation
papers.authors: Xuan-Bach Mai, Duy-Phuc Nguyen, Quoc-Van Le, Tam V. Nguyen, Thanh-Toan Do, Huu Le, Duong-Van Nguyen, Minh-Triet Tran, Trung-Nghia Le
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 3 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-07 (Tuesday, 7 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.CV

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-06
reports.summary: 运行时 arXiv 尚未发布 2026-07-06 新批次；使用最近可用 2026-07-03 官方批次，主体 31 篇、补充 0 篇。
trends: 今日最突出的主线是 world model 和 world-action model 进一步三维化、物理化：PhysMani、ACID、VT-WAM、Bridge-WA、WorldSample 都在把未来预测与机器人动作可执行性、触觉/接触、物理约束连接起来。
3D Gaussian Splatting 继续从渲染表示向可编辑、可评测、可用于 SLAM/语义占用的系统表示扩展：PixGS、DL-SLAM、Semantic Occupancy、Mind the Gap、AnchorSplat、MVFusion-GS 和 Structure-Aware GS 分别覆盖生成、动态建图、开放词表空间理解、benchmark 缺陷和资产修复。
4D/场景生成今天很密集：Align4D、Unified Panoramic-Gaussian、WorldDirector、SimWorlds、SPG-Layout、InvSplat、PointDiT 都指向一个共同目标，即从单图/单目/文本/任意模态得到可探索、可编辑、几何一致的动态三维世界。
人-物/手-物交互和 articulated objects 也有明显进展：JointHOI 用接触图约束 HOI 生成，ComplexMimic 把人-场景交互放进物理仿真，PWM-ArtGen/SAMoR 则补 articulated object 的结构和运动先验。
VLA 方向更强调数据与视角策略：LIME、VLAFlow、The Moving Eye、TAP 说明 embodied AI 不只是学动作头，还要学何时移动相机、怎样构造数据、如何把物理运动能力与语言任务对齐。

papers.title: PhysMani: Physics-principled 3D World Model for Dynamic Object Manipulation
papers.authors: Peng Yun , Shouwang Huang , Hao Li , Jinxi Li , Jianan Wang , Bo Yang
papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 2 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-03 (Friday, 3 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CL, cs.CV, cs.LG
papers.summary: PhysMani 面向动态目标操作，把机器人 world model 明确放到三维和物理约束里，而不是只预测未来视频。它用 3D Gaussian 表示场景，并学习 divergence-free Gaussian velocity field 来预测快速运动物体，再把预测交给 future-aware action policy。对 Physical AI 的价值在于：3DGS 不只是可视化地图，也可以成为带物理结构的操作预测器。
methodHighlights: divergence-free Gaussian velocity field for dynamic objects

papers.title: ACID: Action Consistency via Inverse Dynamics for Planning with World Models
papers.authors: Gawon Seo , Dongwon Kim , Suha Kwak

papers.summary: ACID 关注用 action-conditioned world model 做 decision-time planning 时的“看起来能到达”和“动作上真的可执行”之间的落差。它用 inverse dynamics 检查候选 rollout 的中间状态转移是否与动作一致，而不只看终点是否接近目标。该思路对机器人规划很实用：世界模型评估函数需要惩罚不可实现的漂亮未来。
methodHighlights: inverse-dynamics action consistency for world-model planning
decision-time planner that discourages infeasible rollouts

papers.title: VT-WAM: Visual-Tactile World Action Model for Contact-Rich Manipulation

papers.published: arXiv dateline: [Submitted on 2 Jul 2026]; official announcement batch: 2026-07-03 (Friday, 3 July 2026 official arXiv new/cross listing); categories: cs.RO

papers.authors: Duy Cao , Phong Nguyen-Ha

papers.title: Unified Panoramic-Gaussian Representation for Monocular 4D Scene Synthesis

recovers geometry plus physically meaningful material properties

papers.title: Mind the Gap: Standard 3DGS Evaluation Primarily Measures Near-Trajectory Interpolation

papers.title: Structure-Aware Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction

papers.title: Learning to Move Before Learning to Do: Task-Agnostic pretraining for VLAs

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-03
reports.summary: 今日主体 31 篇、补充 0 篇；重点是物理化 3D world/action models、3DGS 生成/SLAM/语义占用与评测、4D/场景生成、HOI/articulated objects，以及 VLA 数据和视角策略。
trends: 今日最突出的主线是 world model 和 world-action model 进一步三维化、物理化：PhysMani、ACID、VT-WAM、Bridge-WA、WorldSample 都在把未来预测与机器人动作可执行性、触觉/接触、物理约束连接起来。
3D Gaussian Splatting 继续从渲染表示向可编辑、可评测、可用于 SLAM/语义占用的系统表示扩展：PixGS、DL-SLAM、Semantic Occupancy、Mind the Gap、AnchorSplat、MVFusion-GS 和 Structure-Aware GS 分别覆盖生成、动态建图、开放词表空间理解、benchmark 缺陷和资产修复。
4D/场景生成今天很密集：Align4D、Unified Panoramic-Gaussian、WorldDirector、SimWorlds、SPG-Layout、InvSplat、PointDiT 都指向一个共同目标，即从单图/单目/文本/任意模态得到可探索、可编辑、几何一致的动态三维世界。
人-物/手-物交互和 articulated objects 也有明显进展：JointHOI 用接触图约束 HOI 生成，ComplexMimic 把人-场景交互放进物理仿真，PWM-ArtGen/SAMoR 则补 articulated object 的结构和运动先验。
VLA 方向更强调数据与视角策略：LIME、VLAFlow、The Moving Eye、TAP 说明 embodied AI 不只是学动作头，还要学何时移动相机、怎样构造数据、如何把物理运动能力与语言任务对齐。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-02
reports.summary: 今日主体 33 篇、补充 0 篇；重点是 3D/4D world models、3DGS 机器人安全与语义接口、触觉/双臂操作、开放词表 3D scene graph 和可用 3D 资产生成。
trends: 今天最强主线是 world model 进一步三维化和可控化：World from Motion、3D Point World Models、Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model、Path Planning in Physically Viable World Models 都在把未来预测放进 3D/4D geometry、3DGS 或点云空间，而不是只预测像素。
3D Gaussian Splatting 继续从渲染表示转向机器人接口：FastBridge 用 3DGS 做安全过滤，DeWorldSG/NoPA/PairGS 把 Gaussian 表示用于语义图和开放词表分割，FlatMinGS/GADA/GaussianFusion 则补 sparse-view 泛化和多模态融合短板。
机器人操作方向强调长时程、接触和技能复用：ABot-M0.5、FurnitureVLA、H-Tac/TTP、Wake up for Touch! 和 ASPIRE 分别覆盖 world action model、双臂装配、触觉预训练、多模态对齐和自主技能发现。
3D 生成与资产管线关注从几何到可用资产的落地：Pano2World、Ink3D、Restore3D、Stitched Embeddings、SuperFlex 和 Linkify 共同指向多视角世界生成、复杂纹理、损坏修复、服装/装配结构和可解释 primitives。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-07-01
reports.summary: 今日主体 34 篇、补充 0 篇；重点是 simulation-ready 4D scenes、任务条件化 3DGS 地图、Gaussian ray tracing/editing、长程 world model 评测、触觉/人形机器人操作和 occupancy-guided driving simulation。
trends: 今日 3DGS 主线明显从“可看”转向“可维护、可物理编辑、可进入机器人闭环”：GaussLite 把 Gaussian map 的容量分给任务相关区域，Streaming Gaussian Encoding 维护 4D occupancy 的时序一致性，GRay/Editable Reflections/Intrinsic GS 则把 ray tracing、反射和 intrinsic decomposition 带回物理一致渲染。
世界模型方向集中在“长程稳定”和“可用于规划”：PDR 用可微 3DGS 预测视频动态，MemLearner 学习上下文记忆查询，WorldRoamBench 把 interactive world model 的评测推到长时程稳定性和交互物理，DVG-WM 则为机器人操作解耦高层视觉生成与低层接触动态。

机器人操作与 Physical AI 的重点是把几何、接触和安全接口显式化：3D HAMSTER 把 2D VLA 轨迹落成 3D metric guidance，UniTacVLA/RoboTacDex 强化触觉模态，OopsieVerse 把 damage-aware simulation 加进 household manipulation，Human-as-Humanoid 则继续扩展从人类视频学习人形机器人动作的路线。
自动驾驶和仿真数据生成继续把 3D/occupancy 作为控制骨架：Horizon3D 做远距 radar-camera 3D 感知，InfiniVerse 用 occupancy guidance 生成无边界城市场景，DriveWeaver 和 ForgeDrive 分别处理可控车辆插入与 visual-action world model 的误差级联。

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-30
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 34 篇，补充 0 篇；3DGS 地图、具身世界模型和机器人几何接口最突出。
trends: 2026-06-30 官方公告批次里，3D Gaussian Splatting 从单纯 novel view synthesis 继续向可维护地图、语义可查询场景、动态 4D 表示和真实机器人闭环推进：L2D2-GS、KiloGS-SLAM、GaussDet、CubifyGS、MyGO-Splat、StereoGS、Graph-GSReg 和 VCS-SLAM 都在解决长期尺度、稀疏视图、语义一致和地图复用问题。
世界模型和仿真评测的主线更偏“可执行物理”：CrashTwin 用多智能体碰撞检验生成式世界模型是否遵守物理，ViPSim 把 visual space 与 parameter space 协同起来做长时程具身 rollout，OWMDrive 用 4D occupancy world model 为端到端驾驶规划提供未来先验。

机器人方向突出“几何接口进入策略”：VLK 用 3DGS 重建场景合成 humanoid loco-manipulation 监督，ZR-0 用 dense embodied chain-of-thought 对齐跨 embodiment VLA，OpenSPM、SPARK、Event-VLA、YOTO 和 DCGrasp 分别从空间记忆、锚点 keypoint、事件相机、触觉和距离场抓取补上低层几何约束。

HOI、手物交互和 articulated objects 也很密集：CoGS 与 IMU-HOI 强调人-物交互中的组件解耦和接触推理，EPIC-Contact/HOPformer 将 in-the-wild egocentric 手物接触标注推到 3D pose 层面，UnfoldArt 则把 text/image 到 articulated 3D object recovery 做成 agentic debate。
最值得优先深读的是 VLK、L2D2-GS、KiloGS-SLAM、ViPSim、GaussDet、CubifyGS、ZR-0、CoGS、CrashTwin、UnfoldArt 和 EPIC-Contact。它们的共同启发是：三维表示正在从“可看”走向“可问、可维护、可模拟、可规划、可接触”。

papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-29T17:59:55Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.RO/new, cs.AI/new, cs.GR/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.GR, eess.SY

papers.title: L2D2-GS: Learning to Densify for Feedforward Dynamic Gaussian Scene Reconstruction
papers.authors: Zetian Song, Chenming Wu, Junnan Liu, Chitian Sun, Liangliang He, Hangjun Ye, Jiaqi Zhang, Siwei Ma, Wen Gao
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-28T12:51:17Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-30 (/list cs.CV/new, cs.GR/new); categories: cs.CV, cs.GR

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-29
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 26 篇，补充 0 篇；物理世界模型、结构化 3D 生成和机器人策略注入最突出。
trends: 2026-06-29 官方公告批次里，世界模型明显从“能生成视频”转向“能作为物理可用的模拟器”: PhysisForcing、P3Sim、DiM-WAM、CascadeOcc、Directing the World 和 MemoBench 都在处理动作条件、空间记忆、长期 rollout、物理一致性和诊断评测。
三维重建和生成继续走向结构化、可部署: HAT-4D 从单目视频恢复多物体 4D 交互，ReScene 面向仿真就绪室内场景，StructSplat 与 Structured-Li-GS 分别攻克无标定稀疏视图和 LiDAR 约束 3DGS，CoIn 把 2D inpainting 与 3DGS 双向闭环。
机器人方向的重点是显式结构注入策略: SimFoundry 用真实视频构建可编辑 digital twins，Direct Action-Head Injection 把 grounded 3D point 直接喂给动作头，SceneBot/CWI 用接触标签和组合模仿统一 humanoid loco-manipulation。
具身空间评测也在变细: AirGroundBench 评估 UAV-UGV 多视角协作，LocalNav 关注端侧 VLM 物体导航，LXD-SLAM 把多传感器 dense mapping 做成可插拔组合。
最值得优先深读的是 PhysisForcing、P3Sim、HAT-4D、SimFoundry、ReScene、StructSplat、DiM-WAM、DexCompose、CascadeOcc 和 Direct Action-Head Injection。

papers.summary: MemoBench 评估视频世界模型在动态环境中的记忆一致性，特别是物体消失后又以变化状态重新出现的场景。该基准构建 360 个 synthetic 和 real-world clips，并围绕 disappear-and-reappear 设计四类诊断指标。它指出长期闭环世界模型必须记住被遮挡物体在不可见期间发生的物理变化。
methodHighlights: tests object memory under physical changes

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-26
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 25 篇，补充 0 篇；物理世界模型、3DGS 几何保护和接触式机器人操作最突出。
trends: 2026-06-26 官方新公告批次里，3D/4D 表示和世界模型明显向物理可控性靠拢: PhysiFormer、Neural Voxel Dynamics、PhysEditWorld、Fast LeWorldModel、DexAC-WM 和 Hallucination in World Models 都在处理动作、几何、物理状态与长期 rollout 的一致性问题。
3DGS/NeRF 方向的关键词是几何保护和可诊断: SatSplatDiff、PanoImager、SceneStyler、Vis4GS、RayPE 和 Sculpting NeRF Geometry 分别从卫星重建、稀疏全景、风格一致性、训练可解释、射线编码和偏好优化切入。
机器人操作的热点集中在接触和物理反馈: Play2Perfect、VibeAct、Tactile-WAM、PressMimic、RelAfford6D、SSI-Policy 和 Motion Feasibility from Point Clouds 都在把触觉、压力、点云、6D affordance 或阶段结构显式注入策略。
具身数据和评测继续向真实长时程移动: OctoSense、WatchAct、RobOralScan、OmniContact 和 E-TTS 分别补多模态传感、行为 grounding、主动三维扫描、HOI 式 humanoid loco-manipulation 与测试时扩展。

最值得优先深读的是 PhysiFormer、Neural Voxel Dynamics、PhysEditWorld、KRVF、RelAfford6D、VibeAct、Tactile-WAM、RayPE、PanoImager 和 Hallucination in World Models；它们对三维重建、世界模型和 Physical AI 的共同启发是: 仅有视觉逼真不够，模型必须把几何坐标、接触、物理参数、传感来源和数据覆盖显式纳入闭环。

papers.title: PhysiFormer: Learning to Simulate Mechanics in World Space
papers.authors: Yiming Chen, Yushi Lan, Andrea Vedaldi
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:59:00Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: PhysiFormer 把物理世界模型从像素空间转到世界坐标中的 3D mesh 顶点轨迹。模型以初始顶点位置、速度和材料类型为条件，用 diffusion transformer 直接采样刚体或弹性物体的未来运动。它不显式写入刚性、因果或传统仿真器约束，而是通过时间、空间和对象维度分解的 attention 学习多物体动力学。结果对机器人、图形和物理设计都有启发，因为它把可视化世界模型推进到几何坐标和材料条件下的可采样物理预测。
methodHighlights: time-space-object factorized attention for multi-object mechanics
generalizes to mixed materials, real geometries, and larger object counts

papers.title: Neural Voxel Dynamics: Learning Implicit 3D Physics via Volumetric Feature Advection
papers.authors: Zican Wang, Niloy Mitra
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T22:06:35Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇论文同样针对视频世界模型缺少 3D 几何基础的问题，但选择从单目视频监督中自监督学习 3D 体素动力学。方法先用 monocular depth prior 将 V-JEPA 语义特征抬升到 voxel latent space，再用 Volumetric Feature Advection 学习 action-conditioned transition operator。物理状态不再是 2D 图像 token 的隐式漂移，而是在体素特征中被平流和演化。它对动态世界模型的价值在于，用被动视频也能学习保持对象永久性和长期结构稳定的隐式 3D 物理。
methodHighlights: lifts video features into depth-grounded 3D voxel latent space
volumetric feature advection models action-conditioned physical transitions
self-supervised from video-derived signals without simulator internals

papers.title: PhysEditWorld: A Large-Scale Dataset Toward Physics-Editable World Models
papers.authors: Bin Hu, Yanwen Ma, Jiehui Huang, Ziliang Zhang, Haoning Wu, Ruicheng Zhang, Yaokun Li, Zijun Wang, Yuechen Zhang, Chun-Mei Tseng, Hanhui Li, Shengju Qian, Jun Zhou, Kaipeng Zhang, Xiaodan Liang, Jiaya Jia, Xiu Li
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T07:27:09Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: PhysEditWorld 是面向 physics-editable world models 的 UE5 数据集，重点把物理参数从隐式相关性变成显式可控变量。数据通过 replay-and-rendering pipeline 固定初始状态、动作序列和相机策略，只改变重力等物理配置，从而得到可归因的物理变化。它包含 12 个 cinematic 场景、100 多小时交互和 6000 万以上 rollout frames，并同步 RGB、depth、normal、audio、action traces、camera trajectory、engine states、semantic annotations 和 gravity labels。对世界模型研究而言，这是把“能生成”推进到“能物理编辑并保持一致”的基础设施。
methodHighlights: UE5 replay paradigm isolates controllable physical parameters
multimodal rollout data with depth, normals, action traces, camera trajectories, and engine states
utility studies for gravity-faithful video generation and world understanding

papers.title: Fast LeWorldModel
papers.authors: Yuntian Gao, Xiangyu Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:59:59Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.LG/new); categories: cs.LG, cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: Fast LeWorldModel 关注 reconstruction-free visual world model 在规划阶段的计算瓶颈。原 LeWorldModel 需要自回归地一步步 rollout 候选动作序列，规划慢且误差会随 horizon 累积。Fast-LeWM 改为 action-prefix prediction: 对动作序列前缀并行编码，直接预测不同前缀执行后的未来 latent。这样既减少规划时间，也让模型学习多步动作效果如何逐渐累积，对机器人视觉规划中的 latent world model 很实用。
methodHighlights: action-prefix prediction replaces autoregressive latent rollout
parallel evaluation of candidate action sequences
reduces planning time and slows latent error growth over horizon

papers.title: Hallucination in World Models is Predictable and Preventable
papers.authors: Nicklas Hansen, Xiaolong Wang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:38:45Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.LG/new); categories: cs.LG, cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇论文把生成式世界模型的 hallucination 归因到 state-action coverage 的低覆盖区域，而不是简单归咎于模型容量。作者构建 MMBench2，包含 427 小时、210 个任务、真实动作、奖励和 live simulators，并训练 350M 参数世界模型分析错误。论文区分 perceptual、action-marginalized 和 scene-diverging 三类 hallucination，并提出能提前预测失败的轻量信号。更重要的是，这些信号还能作为采样和在线数据收集策略，帮助模型用少量新轨迹适配未见环境。
methodHighlights: MMBench2 with actions, rewards, and live simulators
coverage-aware sampling and curiosity-style targeted data collection

papers.title: Not All Actions Are Equal: Rethinking Conditioning for Dexterous World Model
papers.authors: Zizhao Yuan, Zhengtu Liang, Taowen Wang, Qiwei Liang, Yichi Wang, Yunheng Wang, Yuetong Fang, Lusong Li, Zecui Zeng, Renjing Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:36:35Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: DexAC-WM 指出高自由度 dexterous action 不适合被压成单一全局条件向量，因为大尺度运动和细微接触信号量级差异很大。方法把 action conditioning 结构化为动作 tokenization、local refinement 和 global modulation，保留每个维度的语义和动力学影响。它还加入语义分支，为高自由度视频预测提供 object-scene prior。对手部操作世界模型来说，这篇论文的核心信息是: 结构化动作条件本身是建模能力，不只是附加输入。
methodHighlights: dimension-aware action tokenization for high-DoF dexterous control
local refinement plus global modulation aligns action signals with visual dynamics
semantic branch supplies object-scene priors for action-conditioned prediction

papers.title: RayPE: Ray-Space Positional Encoding for 3D-Aware Video Generation
papers.authors: Minghao Yin, Jiahao Lu, Wenbo Hu, Wang Zhao, Shan Ying, Kai Han
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:51:02Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: RayPE 针对视频 diffusion transformer 的位置编码缺少 3D 场景结构这一问题。作者用 Plucker ray 的 reciprocal product 描述相机射线之间的几何关系，并把每个 token 的 6D Plucker 坐标加到 self-attention 的 query/key 中。注意力分数被分解为内容项、几何项和交叉项，让模型在视频生成中显式感知 camera rays。模块参数量小于 0.1%，可零初始化接入预训练 DiT，却提升相机可控性、跨帧 3D 一致性和视频质量。
methodHighlights: injects per-token 6D Plucker ray coordinates into DiT attention
attention decomposes into content, geometry, and cross terms
handles heterogeneous camera-translation scales with magnitude gating and normalization

papers.title: PanoImager: Geometry-Guided Novel View Synthesis and Reconstruction from Sparse Panoramic Views
papers.authors: Zhisong Xu, Takeshi Oishi
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T14:15:09Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: PanoImager 解决稀疏全景图下 3D 重建的弱视差和旋转主导问题，尤其是 SfM/SLAM 难以初始化的场景。它绕过传统 SfM 初始化，结合 feed-forward pose/depth priors、geometry-conditioned diffusion view completion 和 depth-guided 3DGS optimization。方法将全景图拆成局部透视视图，并合成辅助观察来补足稀疏证据。对室内外全景建图来说，它适合作为 SLAM 初始化失败后的离线或后台几何补强模块。

papers.title: SatSplatDiff: Geometry-preserving generative refinement for high-fidelity satellite Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Jiyong Kim, Shuang Song, Ronjgun Qin
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T16:12:36Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: SatSplatDiff 面向卫星 3D Gaussian Splatting，处理顶部视角监督不足导致建筑立面空洞和渲染质量差的问题。直接用生成模型逐视图 refinement 会带来 hallucination 和 photo-consistency 破坏，进而损伤几何。论文在 photogrammetric DSM initialization 和 2DGS shadow casting 基础上加入 monocular depth supervision、多尺度几何 refinement 和 shadow-guided generative refinement。它的重点不是单纯让图像更好看，而是在传感器一致和几何误差可控的前提下做高分辨率增强。
methodHighlights: monocular depth supervision plus multi-scale geometric refinement
shadow-guided generative refinement preserves satellite scene geometry
reports lower geometric MAE and improved visual fidelity on IARPA2016/DFC2019

papers.title: Capacity-Controlled Multi-View Stylization of 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Zhihao Wen, Yixin Yang, Bojian Wu, Yang Zhou, Dani Lischinski, Daniel Cohen-Or, Hui Huang
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T08:36:50Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇工作把 3DGS 风格化中的跨视角一致性问题表述为带容量约束的局部风格匹配。传统方法在每个渲染视图独立做 2D feature matching，容易出现风格分配不稳定、多对一特征复用和视角不一致。作者用 semi-balanced optimal transport 加 column-capacity constraints 控制 style feature allocation，并加入 cross-view matching guidance 与几何正则。它适合需要可编辑但又不想牺牲场景语义结构的 3DGS 资产生产流程。
methodHighlights: semi-balanced optimal transport for local style matching
cross-view guidance and geometry regularization stabilize 3DGS stylization

papers.title: Vis4GS: A Visual Analytic Tool for 3D Gaussian Splatting Reconstruction
papers.authors: Kai-Yuan Lin, Aryabima Mandala Putra, Jui-Chi Lee, Shih-Hsuan Hung
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T12:59:02Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.GR/new); categories: cs.GR
papers.summary: Vis4GS 不是新的 3DGS 优化算法，而是用于理解和诊断 3DGS 重建失败的可视分析工具。它把最终渲染伪影连接到 Gaussian primitive 属性、view coverage、训练进度和 Gaussian genealogy。系统提供 Gaussian 分析视图、属性时间线、densification tree 和日志控制面板，支持 blur/needle-like artifact scoring。对 3DGS 工程化很有意义，因为它把“看最终图像调参”变成可追溯的 primitive-level 诊断流程。
methodHighlights: links rendered artifacts to Gaussian properties and training history
view coverage and Gaussian genealogy analysis
interactive diagnosis for blur and needle-like artifacts

papers.title: Sculpting NeRF Geometry: Human-Preference Fine-Tuning of a 3D-Aware Face GAN
papers.authors: Archer Moore, Mingming Gong, Liam Hodgkinson
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:26:06Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.CV/new); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇论文把 RLHF 用到 3D-aware face GAN 的 NeRF density field 上，而不是先转 mesh 再做显式表面优化。奖励模型直接读取 radiance-field density 值，不需要文本条件、mesh extraction 或多视角渲染作为中间监督。density-consistency constraint 用来保持 2D 外观尽量稳定，同时重塑 3D 几何。作为 proof of concept，它说明小规模人类偏好也可能直接塑造隐式 3D 生成模型的几何质量。
methodHighlights: preference reward over NeRF density field
fine-tunes 3D-aware GAN without mesh or multi-view rendering supervision
density-consistency constraint trades geometry improvement against bounded appearance drift

papers.title: KRVF: A Source-Aware Semantic Voxel World Representation for Edge Mobile Manipulation
papers.authors: Runfeng Ling
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T19:07:42Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: KRVF 关注移动操作机器人在边缘算力下需要怎样的本地世界模型。它把局部世界状态表示为 task-oriented voxels，编码 occupancy、color、semantic evidence、temporal freshness 和 evidence source。与重建中心的 mapping pipeline 不同，KRVF 区分 measured occupancy 与 semantic-prior hypotheses，避免深度失败时把语义猜测错误地固化进几何。系统还可渲染 map-prior depth 供感知修复，并暴露 semantic objects 和 grasp candidates 等任务查询接口。
methodHighlights: source-aware semantic voxel representation for edge mobile manipulation
separates measured occupancy from semantic-prior hypotheses
map-prior depth rendering and task-level query operators for robot memory

papers.title: Play2Perfect: What Matters in Dexterous Play Pretraining for Precise Assembly?
papers.authors: Tyler Ga Wei Lum, Kushal Kedia, C. Karen Liu, Jeannette Bohg
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T22:39:12Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI
papers.summary: Play2Perfect 研究多指灵巧手在精密装配前是否应该先通过 task-agnostic play 学会通用 manipulation priors。预训练阶段让机器人在多对象、多目标上学习 grasping、in-hand reorientation 和 pose reaching，随后再 finetune 到高精度接触任务。论文系统比较 object diversity、training objective、trajectory diversity 和 goal precision 等因素。结果显示 play prior 比从零 RL 高 33 倍样本效率，并能 zero-shot sim-to-real 迁移到 0.5 mm 间隙的 tight insertion。
methodHighlights: finetuning focuses exploration on precise contact-rich assembly
systematic analysis of diversity, objective, trajectory, and goal precision

papers.title: VibeAct: Vibration to Actions for Contact-Rich Reactive Robot Dexterity
papers.authors: Yuemin Mao, Uksang Yoo, Jean Oh, Jonathan Francis, Jeffrey Ichnowski
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T17:50:07Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: VibeAct 用嵌入灵巧手的压电麦克风捕捉高带宽 vibro-acoustic 接触信号，解决视觉遮挡下接触和滑移难以感知的问题。真实数据通过 teleoperation 采集，再在 calibrated digital clone 中回放，自动标注每个手指的 contact 和 slip。策略并不需要在仿真里生成原始音频，而是在真实和仿真之间共享 contact/slip 物理表示。对接触丰富的 regrasping、in-hand reorientation 和 insertion，持续滑移通道成为反应式控制的重要观测。
methodHighlights: piezoelectric microphones provide high-bandwidth vibrotactile sensing
real recordings replayed in a calibrated digital clone for contact/slip labels
policies train on shared physical contact/slip representation instead of raw audio simulation

papers.title: Tactile-WAM: Touch-Aware World Action Model with Tactile Asymmetric Attention
papers.authors: Siyu Wu, Linjing You, Junjie Zhu, Yaozu Liu, Changhao Zhang, Jian Liu, Weiqiang Wang, Qi Li, Jituo Li, Hengshuang Zhao
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T06:54:56Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: Tactile-WAM 把 tactile prediction 接进 World Action Model，但先识别了一个关键失败模式: tactile pollution。若无约束地把稀疏、局部、事件驱动的触觉 token 注入视觉动力学模型，反而会污染视频和动作预测。作者提出 Tactile Asymmetric Attention Mechanism，用 VideoClean mask 阻止 video query 访问 tactile key/value，同时让 action query 保留触觉信息，并用 touch-aware bias 调节动作 attention。它说明触觉世界模型不是简单多模态拼接，而需要非对称的信息路由。
methodHighlights: identifies tactile pollution in touch-augmented WAMs
VideoClean mask protects visual prediction while action queries use tactile tokens
touch-aware attention bias improves contact-rich manipulation success

papers.title: RelAfford6D: Relational 6D Affordance Graphs for Constraint-Driven Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Guodong Zhang, Qichen He, Wenyuan Xie, Shaokai Wu, Yanbiao Ji, Qiuchang Li, Bayram Bayramli, Yue Ding, Hongtao Lu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T13:42:26Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: RelAfford6D 用训练自由的 Relational 6D Affordance Graph 连接自然语言指令、物体部件关系和可执行 6D 约束。系统先推断 primary interacting part 与 physical anchor 之间的语义拓扑，再用 vision foundation models 提升到 metric SE(3) poses。后续执行被写成 kinematic constraint satisfaction，机器人沿 revolute 或 prismatic manifolds 生成连续轨迹。对 articulated objects 操作来说，这种显式几何约束比孤立 contact point 或 latent affordance 更可解释、也更容易闭环修正。
methodHighlights: relational 6D affordance graph links interactive parts and physical anchors
vision foundation models lift semantic topology to metric SE(3) poses
analytic kinematic constraints for revolute/prismatic articulated manipulation

papers.title: SSI-Policy: Learning Structured Scene Interfaces for Vision-Language Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Kaijun Wang, Zikai Ouyang, Xuping Wu, Jinyi Hong, Wei Pan, Haibo Lu, Jia Pan, Wei Zhang, Linfang Zheng
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T09:38:05Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: SSI-Policy 为低数据机器人操作构造了 Structured Scene Interface，把语义 grounding、几何结构和运动提示放在一个 RGB-only 中间表示里。SSI 同时编码 monocular depth features、language-grounded object layouts 和 instruction-conditioned 2D motion trajectories。它从 action-free video 训练，和下游控制解耦，因此少量示范就能学习策略。对 VLA finetuning 的启发是，显式场景接口可以在不依赖深度传感器的情况下保留几何和运动线索。
methodHighlights: RGB-only Structured Scene Interface with depth, object layout, and motion cues
trainable from action-free video and robot-agnostic
improves low-demo LIBERO and real-world manipulation

papers.title: Learning Motion Feasibility from Point Clouds in Cluttered Environments
papers.authors: Sajid Ansari, Arthi, Girish Varma, Antony Thomas
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T07:32:25Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI
papers.summary: 这篇论文把 motion feasibility prediction 直接建立在 cluttered scene 的 RGB-D/point cloud 观测上，减少 sampling-based motion planner 的无效尝试。作者构建包含 88 个扫描物体、190 个 cluttered tabletop scenes 和 270 万 grasp feasibility labels 的大规模 benchmark。比较 MLP、volumetric CNN 和 point-cloud Transformer 后，最佳 GRASPFC-PTX 在 novel objects 上达到 0.996 AUROC。它适合与任务与运动规划结合，作为几何场景到可行抓取/运动判断的快速过滤器。
methodHighlights: large benchmark with 2.7M grasp feasibility labels
raw RGB-D/point-cloud input for 7-DOF manipulation in clutter
point-cloud transformer predicts feasibility far faster than repeated SBMP attempts

papers.title: PressMimic: Pressure-Guided Motion Capture and Control for Humanoid Robot Imitation
papers.authors: Yi Lu, Shenghao Ren, Tianyu Xiong, Zhaoxiang Li, Jiaqi Li, He Zhang, Tao Yu, Qiu Shen, Xun Cao
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-25T08:24:35Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-26 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: PressMimic 认为 humanoid motion imitation 不能只依赖视觉动捕和运动学 imitation，因为接触动力学缺失会造成脚滑、穿地和不稳定。它把压力作为从感知到控制的统一物理 grounding 信号。FRAPPE++ 融合 RGB 和压力来估计 3D pose 与 global motion，压力提供接触和支撑约束来消除视觉歧义。控制阶段的 pressure-supervised policy 则把压力派生信号注入 RL，使 humanoid 执行时接触模式更物理一致。
methodHighlights: RGB-plus-pressure motion capture for 3D pose and global motion
pressure-derived contact/support constraints reduce kinematic ambiguity
pressure-supervised humanoid control improves stable contact execution

papers.title: OmniContact: Chaining Meta-Skills via Contact Flow for Generalizable Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

导航和 SLAM 方向更强调语义地图与长期记忆: RoboAtlas、RAVEN、SAGE-Nav 和 fARfetch 都把 3D/空间结构放在 VLM/LLM 推理之前，避免只依赖语言模型临场猜测。

papers.title: Learning Action Priors for Cross-embodiment Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Dong Jing, Tianqi Zhang, Jiaqi Liu, Jinman Zhao, Zelong Sun, Li Erran Li, Zhiwu Lu, Mingyu Ding
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T17:59:56Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇论文指出，现有 VLA 往往直接在视觉-语言 backbone 后接动作模块，动作时间结构需要从零开始学，尤其在跨 embodiment 任务中收敛慢、数据效率低。作者先用未条件化动作轨迹预训练一个轻量 flow-matching encoder-decoder 动作模块，再把 decoder 和 latent distillation 迁移进 VLA 训练。训练好的 encoder 还能把状态-动作历史压成一个时间上下文 token，用极小代价支持 history-aware policy。结果显示，在 13 个仿真和真实跨 embodiment 任务上，动作先验带来更快收敛、更高成功率和更强低数据泛化。
methodHighlights: two-stage training: action-prior pretraining before visual-language-action alignment
flow-matching action module learns temporal motion structure from raw action trajectories
latent distillation and decoder reuse transfer the prior into cross-embodiment VLA policies

papers.title: In-Context World Modeling for Robotic Control
papers.authors: Siyin Wang, Junhao Shi, Senyu Fei, Zhaoyang Fu, Li Ji, Jingjing Gong, Xipeng Qiu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T16:53:36Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: ICWM 把机器人系统辨识改写成 in-context adaptation 问题，而不是每遇到新相机视角或机器人形态就重新微调。策略在执行任务前先观察一小段自生成、任务无关交互历史，从中推断当前系统的关键变量和动力学。这里的上下文不是告诉模型“做什么任务”，而是让模型理解“这个系统如何运作”。仿真和真实平台实验表明，这种 world modeling 上下文显著提升 VLA 对新视角和新配置的泛化。
methodHighlights: uses short self-generated interaction histories for in-context system identification
separates how-the-world-works context from task demonstrations
adapts robotic control to novel camera viewpoints and robot configurations without parameter updates

papers.title: RoboAtlas: Contextual Active SLAM
papers.authors: Alexander Schperberg, Shivam K. Panda, Abraham P. Vinod, M. K. Jawed, Stefano Di Cairano

large real-world deployment plus GOAT-Bench evaluation

papers.title: ForceBand: Learning Forceful Manipulation with sEMG
papers.authors: Botao He, Zhi Wang, Linna Kuang, Ishaan Ghosh, Jitendra Malik, Cornelia Fermuller, Tingfan Wu, Jiayuan Mao, Ruoshi Liu, Haozhi Qi, Yiannis Aloimonos

10-hour multimodal dataset with egocentric video and fingertip force measurements
force-augmented demonstrations improve manipulation requiring contact-force control

papers.authors: Hao Sun, Hao Yan, Mengting Chen, Quanjian Song, Yu Li, Juan Cao, Jinsong Lan, Xiaoyong Zhu, Bo Zheng, Sheng Tang

papers.authors: JoungBin Lee, Jaewoo Jung, Jongmin Lee, Tongmin Kim, Hyunsung Kim, Takuya Narihira, Kazumi Fukuda, Jahyeok Koo, Jisang Han, Yuki Mitsufuji, Seungryong Kim

routes correspondence-rich attention features into an auxiliary tracking head
improves geometric and motion consistency for 4D video generation

papers.title: From Sparse and Imperfect 2D Anchors to Consistent 3D Gaussian Street Scenes: Support-Aware Appearance
papers.authors: Long Cao, Zhongquan Wang, Jie Li, Yuhan Chen, Kefei Qian, Xiangfei Huang, Guofa Li

papers.summary: 这篇工作处理 3D Gaussian street scenes 的外观编辑/条件迁移问题: 2D 图像先验能生成目标条件，但独立编辑多视角会产生不一致噪声。论文用 teacher-relative appearance residual distillation 构建频率分解、置信估计和 primitive-level lifting 的结构化空间。support-aware Gaussian-space aggregation 只接纳被多视角支持的细节，并抑制 unsupported noise，最后把残差烘焙进固定几何的 SH 系数。对自动驾驶 3DGS 场景资产来说，这是把 2D 生成先验落到可部署 3D 表示的一步。

confidence-gated coarse-to-fine optimization suppresses unsupported 2D noise
fixed-geometry SH coefficients keep standard rasterizer deployment

papers.title: DSP-SLAM++: A Unified Framework for Multi-Class, High-Fidelity Object SLAM in the Wild
papers.authors: Ahmad Kourani, Ghina Daoud, Daniel Asmar, Imad Elhajj

sensor fusion adaptations for monocular fisheye-LiDAR setups
high-fidelity semantically coherent object reconstruction in the wild

papers.title: DynaMOMA: Instantaneous Prediction of Grasp Poses for Mobile Manipulation of Dynamic Objects
papers.authors: Zhinan Yu, Junyan Xu, Jiazhao Zhang, Zheng Qin, Yijie Tang, Yuhang Huang, Yihan Cao, Zhiyuan Yu, Yongjun Wang, Renjiao Yi, Chenyang Zhu, Kai Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T01:58:15Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: DynaMOMA 研究移动机器人抓取动态物体时，底盘、机械臂和目标连续变化之间的协调。方法用 anchor-based diffusion model 根据历史观测预测短时、时间一致的 grasp trajectories，再把轨迹编码成 compact feature 输入 whole-body RL policy。anticipation-guided reward 会把策略目标从当前抓取观测自适应前移到预测抓取轨迹，给机器人留出提前量。它对动态抓取的启发是，将抓取预测作为 whole-body control 的显式前瞻变量，而不是只做即时反应。
methodHighlights: anchor-based diffusion predicts short-horizon grasp trajectories
whole-body RL policy consumes trajectory features for mobile manipulation
anticipation-guided reward shifts control target toward predicted future grasp poses

papers.title: RigPI: Dynamic Parameter Identification of Rigid Body via VLM-Seeded Differentiable Simulation
papers.authors: Xincheng He, Rongrong Zhang, Wei Jiang, Wenqiang Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-23T22:15:42Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO

methodHighlights: VLM-seeded initialization and constrained search for physical parameters
differentiable simulation refines inertial and frictional properties
handles unconstrained and multi-link rigid bodies during robot-object interaction

papers.title: GRAFT: Graph-Based Affordance Transfer via Part Correspondence
papers.authors: Mengying Lin, Utkarsh Mishra, Ajay Mandlekar, Danfei Xu
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-23T23:58:57Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO

combines functional similarity with geometric part alignment
propagates contact points for zero-shot manipulation transfer from one demonstration

papers.title: DeformGen: Dynamics-Based Topology Augmentation for Deformable Manipulation Policy Learning
papers.authors: Zili Lin, Wenyao Zhang, Yuyang Zhang, Zekun Qi, Junyan Lin, Hanxin Zhu, Jiaolong Yang, Zhibo Chen, Yao Mu, Xiaokang Yang, Xin Jin, Wenjun Zeng
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T15:15:38Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: DeformGen 针对 deformable manipulation 的数据增强问题，指出刚体式位姿扰动无法生成物理可达且拓扑合理的变形状态。方法对可变形物体施加局部物理扰动，再 forward-simulate dynamics 得到 topology-coherent states。轨迹迁移则通过 deformation-field warping，把粒子位移提升为连续空间函数，从而同步调整末端执行器轨迹。它把 state augmentation 和 behavior augmentation 绑定在同一物理过程里，对布料、绳索、软物体操作很有价值。

deformation-field warping transfers manipulation trajectories across changed topology
augments state distribution and associated behavior jointly for policy learning

decouples semantic target reasoning from geometric control for low-data imitation learning

papers.title: AISPO: Enhancing Depth Reliability for Robotic Manipulation of Non-Lambertian Objects via Affine-Invariant Shape Prior
papers.authors: Zhiming Chen, Linfang Zheng, Kun Zhang, Hyung Jin Chang, Wei Zhang, Hongyu Yu, Hua Chen
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-24T07:37:11Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-25 (/list cs.RO/new); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: AISPO 解决透明和高反光物体导致 RGB-D 深度缺失或错误的问题，这些错误会直接传播到抓取规划。方法结合多尺度 RGB-D feature fusion 和 affine-invariant shape prior，不只优化平均深度误差，而是强调物理可用性和结构完整性。真实抓取实验显示，更可靠的深度显著提升非 Lambertian 物体操作成功率。对机器人三维感知而言，深度补全的评价目标应从像素精度转向规划可执行性。

multi-scale RGB-D fusion targets transparent and specular objects

papers.title: TacVerse: A Multi-Sensor Dataset and Benchmark for Cross-Sensor Vision-Based Tactile Perception

papers.title: G2DP: Diffusion Planning with Spatio-Temporal Grid Guidance
papers.authors: Hang Yu, Ye Jin, Alessandro Canevaro, Julian Schmidt, Julian Jordan, Peizheng Li, Marc Kaufeld, Silvan Lindner, Johannes Betz, Wilhelm Stork

combines probabilistic future occupancy with route-progress constraints

papers.title: RAVEN: Long-Horizon Reasoning & Navigation with a Visuo-Spatio-Temporal Memory

papers.summary: RAVEN 面向长期部署机器人所需的视觉-空间-时间记忆。它把视觉 embedding 连同位姿和时间存入向量数据库，并通过空间地图约束检索，用于长程问答和自然语言目标导航。相比把图像先转成 caption，直接在视觉 embedding 上检索能保留更细粒度语义，同时降低 retrieval cost。Unitree Go1 室内导航部署表明，这类 memory system 是把 VLM 接入长期具身任务的关键中间层。

spatial map grounds retrieval for question answering and navigation

joint video question-answering objective trains memory-dependent reasoning
sparse attention reduces memory drift during closed-loop control

papers.title: SAGE-Nav: Leveraging LLM Planning and Alignment Fusion for Hierarchical Scene Graph-Guided Navigation

hierarchical scene graph encoder preserves semantic and spatial topology
goal-aware alignment fusion connects real-time perception with graph priors

papers.title: Self-supervised Garment Dynamics with Persistent Wrinkles

papers.title: fARfetch: Enabling Collocated AR-HRC in Large Visually Diverse Environments with VLM-Driven AR Content Adaptation

world-in-miniature interface for path authoring in large environments

papers.title: Beyond a Shadow of a Doubt: Close Proximity Geometry Reconstruction Using FMCW Radar Shadow Effects
papers.authors: Felix de Trogoff du Boisguezennec, Benjamin Ramtoula, Daniele De Martini

extends 2D rotating radar from localization toward close-range reconstruction

reports.title: arXiv 三维视觉与 Physical AI 日报 - 2026-06-24
reports.summary: 最近一天命中 29 篇，补充 0 篇；3DGS/显式资产、几何 VLA、world-model value 和 physics-aware policy 最突出。
trends: 最新 2026-06-24 公告批次的三维视觉主线明显转向“可用资产和可交互表示”: ArtiTwinSplat、Pocket-SLAM、FLAT、FLUX3D、OrbitForge、3DCarGen 和 MM-TRELLIS 都在把 3DGS、triangle splats、mesh 或点云条件推向可渲染、可仿真、可部署的 3D 资产。
机器人方向的重点是让 VLA 和 diffusion policy 更接近真实物理约束: InSight 做自引导技能获取，G^3VLA 注入几何归纳偏置，NoContactNoWorries 和 TACTFUL 强调接触/触觉，Physics-Guided Diffusion Control 与 Cloth Sim-in-the-Loop 则把可行性校验和模拟器放到推理时。
世界模型继续从“预测视频”扩展为“规划和价值接口”: World Value Models 用 world model 估计机器人轨迹价值，NavWM 用视觉 foresight 做闭环导航，DynaWM 用 world model 约束运动表示。
3D 生成评估正在变严: GeoT2V-Bench 明确用重建诊断 text-to-video 的 3D 一致性，OrbitForge 也强调 coverage-aware evaluation，说明视觉逼真度已经不足以支撑 3D asset generation。

最值得优先深读的是 ArtiTwinSplat、InSight、FLAT、FLUX3D、OrbitForge、World Value Models、G^3VLA、NoContactNoWorries、NavWM 和 Pocket-SLAM；它们分别对应 articulated 3DGS digital twin、自主技能增长、显式表面生成、3DGS 原生生成、视频先验到 3D 场景、world-model value learning、几何 VLA、接触估计、导航 world model 和可扩展 3DGS-SLAM。

papers.title: ArtiTwinSplat: Interactable Digital Twin Reconstruction via Gaussian Splatting from RGB-D videos

unsupervised articulation discovery recovers part structure and joint kinematics

papers.title: InSight: Self-Guided Skill Acquisition via Steerable VLAs

targets autonomous skill growth for generalist robot manipulation

papers.title: FLAT: Feedforward Latent Triangle Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Scene Generation
papers.authors: Orest Kupyn, Goutam Bhat, Philipp Henzler, Fabian Manhardt, Christian Rupprecht, Federico Tombari
papers.published: arXiv API published 2026-06-23T17:53:41Z; official announcement batch: 2026-06-24 (/list cs.* new); categories: cs.CV

methodHighlights: decodes triangle splats directly from video diffusion latents
ray-centered rotation parameterization for stable triangle regression
test-time refinement produces opaque real-time renderable assets

papers.title: FLUX3D: High-Fidelity 3D Gaussian Generation with Diffusion-Aligned Sparse Representation
papers.authors: Haorui Ji, Weizhe Liu, Hongdong Li, Hengkai Guo

papers.title: OrbitForge: Text-to-3D Scene Generation via Reconstruction-Anchored Video Synthesis
papers.authors: Chenrui Fan, Paolo Favaro

coverage-aware text-to-3D scene generation without task-specific fine-tuning

papers.title: Grounding Generative Policies in Physics: Optimization-Guided Diffusion for Robot Control

papers.title: Pose6DAug: Physically Plausible Multi-view Object Swapping for Robot Data Augmentation
papers.authors: Jonghoon Lee, Seong Hyeon Park, Byungwoo Jeon, Minha Lee, Jinwoo Shin
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T11:41:25Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO, cs.LG
papers.summary: Pose6DAug uses successful multi-view robot episodes as physically valid seeds for novel-object data augmentation. It swaps only the manipulated object in 3D, drives an explicit mesh with a temporally coherent 6D pose trajectory, and preserves cross-view consistency under occlusion and egocentric viewpoints. The result is targeted VLA fine-tuning data for failure modes without new teleoperation collection.
methodHighlights: explicit mesh and temporally coherent 6D object pose
multi-view physically plausible rendering for VLA generalization

papers.title: One Demo is Worth a Thousand Trajectories: Action-View Augmentation for Visuomotor Policies
papers.authors: Chuer Pan, Litian Liang, Dominik Bauer, Eric Cousineau, Benjamin Burchfiel, Siyuan Feng, Shuran Song
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-17T20:41:13Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: This work turns a single real eye-in-hand demonstration into many realistic and physically feasible action-view trajectories. It reconstructs and edits the scene with a fisheye-aware Gaussian Splatting formulation, then uses trajectory optimization to produce smooth collision-free paths and corresponding novel-view observations. It is a practical example of using 3DGS as a robot data augmentation engine rather than only a renderer.
methodHighlights: trajectory optimization for collision-free rendered views

papers.title: EquiVLA: A General Framework for Rotationally Equivariant Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Thien-Loc Ha, Quang-Tan Nguyen, Trong-Bao Ho, Long Dinh, Minh Duc Nguyen, Gia-Binh Nguyen, Pham Tri Quang, Minh N. Vu, Duy M. H. Nguyen, An Thai Le, Ngo Anh Vien
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T04:36:57Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: EquiVLA injects SO(2) equivariance into VLA policies to improve orientation generalization without simply scaling data. EquiPerceptor extracts approximately equivariant visual representations from frozen ViT features, while EquiActor provides an exactly equivariant flow-matching action head. It shows strong gains across LIBERO, CALVIN, and real Mobile ALOHA tasks.
methodHighlights: EquiActor for equivariant flow-matching action prediction

papers.title: Co-VLA: Coordination-Aware Structured Action Modeling for Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Systems
papers.authors: Yandong Wang, Jiaqian Yu, Xiongfeng Peng, Lu Xu, Yamin Mao, Weiming Li, Jaewook Yoo, Dongwook Lee, Daehyun Ji, Mingbo Zhao, Chao Zhang
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T14:28:37Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: Co-VLA argues that implicit coordination is not enough for tightly coupled dual-arm VLA tasks. It replaces the monolithic action head with a Structured Action Expert that separates shared coordination intent from arm-specific residual execution latents. A Latent-Aware Controller then adjusts synchronization, asymmetry, smoothness, and safety at deployment.
methodHighlights: shared coordination latent plus arm residual latents
Latent-Aware Controller for dual-arm execution constraints

papers.title: EventVLA: Event-Driven Visual Evidence Memory for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.authors: Ganlin Yang, Zhangzheng Tu, Yuqiang Yang, Sitong Mao, Junyi Dong, Tianxing Chen, Jiaqi Peng, Jing Xiong, Jiafei Cao, Jifeng Dai, Wengang Zhou, Yao Mu, Tai Wang
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T11:11:37Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: EventVLA addresses long-horizon manipulation failures caused by visual evidence becoming occluded or unobservable. It stores sparse causal visual events through foundational anchors and a dynamic Keyframe Evidence Memory that predicts future keyframe utility from VLA embeddings. The approach targets non-Markovian manipulation without a massive visual history buffer.
methodHighlights: future-utility keyframe prediction from VLA latents

papers.title: ImageWAM: Do World Action Models Really Need Video Generation, or Just Image Editing?
papers.authors: Yuyang Zhang, Wenyao Zhang, Zekun Qi, He Zhang, Haitao Lin, Jingbo Zhang, Yao Mu, Xiaokang Yang, Wenjun Zeng, Xin Jin
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-17T19:25:28Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: ImageWAM challenges the assumption that robot world action models need full future video generation. It reuses denoising KV caches from a pretrained image editing model as compact world-action context for a flow-matching action expert, without decoding target frames at inference. The result focuses compute on action-relevant visual changes and reports lower FLOPs and latency than video-based WAMs.
methodHighlights: image-editing prior instead of full video generation
denoising KV caches as world-action context
flow-matching action expert conditioned on task-relevant visual change

papers.title: MemoryWAM: Efficient World Action Modeling with Persistent Memory
papers.authors: Sizhe Yang, Juncheng Mu, Tianming Wei, Chenhao Lu, Xiaofan Li, Linning Xu, Zhengrong Xue, Zhecheng Yuan, Dahua Lin, Jiangmiao Pang, Huazhe Xu
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T17:59:51Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: MemoryWAM targets non-Markovian real-world manipulation where fixed-window WAMs forget useful history and full-history WAMs become expensive. It combines recent frames, event-boundary anchor frames, and compact gist tokens, then retrieves both detailed short-term and compressed long-term context with a tailored attention mechanism. The key contribution is persistent memory for WAMs without sequence-length-proportional cost growth.
methodHighlights: hybrid memory with recent frames, event anchors, and gist tokens
attention over detailed short-term and compressed long-term context

papers.title: HumanScale: Egocentric Human Video Can Outperform Real-Robot Data for Embodied Pretraining
papers.authors: Juncheng Ma, Jianxin Bi, Yufan Deng, Xuanran Zhai, Kewei Zhang, Ye Huang, Bo Liang, Shukai Gong, Jiankai Tu, Xiaotian Tang, Jiaxin Li, Kaiqi Chen, Duomin Wang, Yuqi Wang, Bingyi Kang, Eric Huang, Zhiyang Dou, Zhen Dong, Enze Xie, Wojciech Matusik, Tat-Seng Chua, Daquan Zhou
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T17:37:34Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: HumanScale systematically compares egocentric human video and teleoperated real-robot trajectories for embodied pretraining. Under fixed post-training and validation protocols, filtered and labeled human video can outperform equal-volume robot data for action prediction and OOD real-robot execution. It supports a scalable recipe: learn diverse world representations from egocentric human video, then align action space with smaller robot datasets.
methodHighlights: controlled comparison of egocentric human video and real-robot data
filtering and labeling pipeline for embodied pretraining
human-video pretraining plus small robot action alignment

papers.title: Generating Robot Hands from Human Demonstrations
papers.authors: Sha Yi, Nicklas Hansen, Xueqian Bai, Carmelo Sferrazza, Michael T. Tolley, Xiaolong Wang
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T17:57:21Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: This paper uses human manipulation data to design robot hands, not only to train controllers. More than four million frames of human fingertip motion guide the optimization of tree-structured hands that can reproduce desired motions with simple inverse-kinematics fingertip matching. It shows human data can shape robot embodiment for dexterous manipulation.
methodHighlights: human fingertip trajectories for robot hand morphology search
RL actor accelerates design and joint-angle search

papers.title: 3D-DLP: Self-Supervised 3D Object-Centric Scene Representation Learning
papers.authors: Ellina Zhang, Madhaven Iyengar, Amir Zadeh, Chuan Li, Deepak Pathak, David Held, Tal Daniel
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-17T18:00:08Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.LG, cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: 3D-DLP decomposes RGB-D or voxel observations into object-centric 3D latent particles. Each particle stores interpretable geometry and appearance attributes such as 3D keypoint position, bounding box size, and visual features. The compact representation improves downstream manipulation compared with dense 3D inputs or non-3D baselines.
methodHighlights: 3D latent particles for object-centric scene representation
compact 3D latent state for robot manipulation

papers.title: TaCauchy: An Extensible FEM Framework for Vision-Based Tactile Simulation
papers.authors: Hengfei Zhao, Yifan Xie, Junhao Gong, Yue Sun, Kai Zhu, Weihua He, Shoujie Li, Haohuan Fu, Wenbo Ding
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T16:08:45Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: TaCauchy provides high-fidelity FEM simulation for vision-based tactile sensors inside Isaac Sim. It computes Cauchy stress tensors from hyperelastic laws through UIPC, projects stress to contact surfaces, and exposes physically grounded force and pressure supervision. This is directly relevant to contact-rich manipulation and Physical AI simulation.
methodHighlights: FEM and UIPC-based tactile stress simulation
sensor interfaces for GelSight Mini, DIGIT, and 9DTact

papers.title: Occ-VLM: Occupancy Grounded Vision Language Model for Indoor Scene Understanding
papers.authors: Jianing Li, Zhou Fang, Yijiang Liu, Li Du
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T04:24:28Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: Occ-VLM uses posed RGB images and a single 2D vision encoder for 3D indoor scene understanding. It reconstructs 3D occupancy as an auxiliary prior and uses it to associate foreground 2D tokens with 3D space before LLM decoding. The design reuses 2D VLM semantics while adding geometry grounding for embodied scene reasoning.
methodHighlights: multi-view occupancy, 3D VQA, and dense captioning evaluation

papers.title: 3D Scene Graphs: Open Challenges and Future Directions
papers.authors: Dennis Rotondi, Francesco Argenziano, Sebastian Koch, Nathan Hughes, Martin Buechner, Johanna Wald, Lukas Rosenberger Schmid, Daniele Nardi, Abhinav Valada, Liam Paull, Federico Tombari, Luca Carlone, Kai O. Arras
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-15T08:14:08Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: This survey formalizes 3D Scene Graphs and reviews their role as semantically grounded, relational 3D representations for spatial AI. It covers modeling choices, construction pipelines, dynamic and affordance-aware graph extensions, and evaluation gaps. It is useful as a roadmap for robotics scene understanding, navigation, planning, and manipulation.
methodHighlights: review of graph construction from raw sensor observations
discussion of intrinsic graph quality and task-level evaluation

papers.title: VisDom: Sparse Novel View Synthesis with Visible Domain Constraint
papers.authors: Mariia Gladkova*, Tarun Yenamandra*, Edmond Boyer, Robert Maier, Tony Tung, Daniel Cremers
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T17:45:37Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: VisDom introduces a learning-free visible-domain constraint for sparse novel view synthesis. It extends visual hull carving by requiring a 3D point to be observed by at least K views, filtering silhouette-consistent but geometrically invalid regions. The constraint plugs into NeRF and Gaussian Splatting pipelines to improve sparse-view object reconstruction.
methodHighlights: visible-domain filtering stronger than silhouette consistency
compatible with NeRF and Gaussian Splatting

papers.title: Geometry-Preserving in 3D Gaussian Splatting for LiDAR-Camera Extrinsic Calibration
papers.authors: Kyoleen Kwak, Daeho Kim, Jeong Woon Lee, Hyoseok Hwang
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T11:23:33Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.CV
papers.summary: This paper addresses geometry drift in 3DGS proxies used for targetless LiDAR-camera extrinsic calibration. It aggregates multi-view LiDAR observations for dense depth supervision and blocks photometric gradients from updating Gaussian spatial parameters. The focus is keeping metric geometry accurate instead of optimizing only for rendering quality.
methodHighlights: photometric-gradient blocking for Gaussian spatial parameters
targetless LiDAR-camera calibration with metric geometry preservation

papers.title: MMD-SLAM: Structure-Enhanced Multi-Meta Gaussian Distribution-Guided Visual SLAM
papers.authors: Fan Zhu, Ziyu Chen, Peichen Liu, Yifan Zhao, Zhisong Xu, Hui Zhu, Hongxing Zhou, Sixun Liu, Chunmao Jiang
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T07:33:08Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: MMD-SLAM combines 3DGS-based visual SLAM with Atlanta World structural priors. It adds point-line fusion for pose optimization, uses dominant-direction Multi-Meta Gaussians to encode scene structure, and evolves Gaussians according to geometry. The goal is better tracking and more consistent photorealistic mapping.

Gaussian evolution guided by scene geometry

papers.title: LIT-GS: LiDAR-Inertial-Thermal Gaussian Splatting for Illumination-Robust Mapping
papers.authors: Shikuan Shi, Chunran Zheng, Jiaming Xu, Tianyong Ye, Tao Yu, Yukang Cui
papers.published: arXiv v1 submitted 2026-06-18T16:06:52Z; announcement batch: 2026-06-19 (Friday, 19 June 2026); categories: cs.RO
papers.summary: LIT-GS improves Gaussian mapping under illumination changes and weak texture by adding thermal sensing and LiDAR plane geometry. It builds confidence-aware thermal-LiDAR anchors, adds point-to-plane residuals into bundle adjustment, and regularizes differentiable splatting with LiDAR planes. The result targets robust robot mapping beyond RGB-friendly conditions.

papers.title: Holo-World: Unified Camera, Object and Weather Control for Video World Model
papers.authors: Xiangchen Yin, Wenzhang Sun, Jiahui Yuan, Zijie Liu, Yinda Chen, Wei Li, Dachun Kai, Chunfeng Wang, Xiaoyan Sun

papers.summary: Holo-World starts from a single image and controls camera motion, object motion, and weather state in a unified video world model. Its Unified Scene Adapter separates world preservation and weather transfer, using geometry buffers and object controls to maintain structure while modifying environmental appearance. It is relevant to controllable 3D-aware video generation and world modeling.
methodHighlights: unified camera, object, and weather control

papers.title: See-and-Reach: Precise Vision-Language Navigation for UAVs within the Field of View
papers.authors: Fanfu Xue, En Yu, Yantian Shen, Zhikun Hu, Hongjun Wang, Yang Yang, Xindi Wang, Jiande Sun

high-resolution front and downward egocentric observations

papers.title: SCAN-Planner: Spatial Collision-Aware Local Planning for Route-Guided Long-Range Quadruped Navigation
papers.authors: Han Zheng, Zhe Chen, Yiwen Fu, Ming Yang, Tong Qin

papers.summary: SCAN-Planner is a spatial collision-aware local planner for quadruped navigation in tight passages, clutter, stairs, and 3D unstructured scenes. It models the elongated robot body with a yaw-aware twin-cylinder footprint and checks whole-body collision through sparse queries in an inflated 3D occupancy map. A projected A* search and robot-centric sliding map support long-range deployment.
methodHighlights: whole-body collision checking in inflated 3D occupancy maps
projected A* and sliding local map for long-range navigation

papers.authors: Xirui Kang, Yanpei Shi, Lucy Liang, Roy Gan, Dongxiu Liu, Pushi Zhang, Danpeng Chen, Xiaoyi Qin, Yinan Zheng, Jinliang Zheng, Hao Wang, Xianyuan Zhan, Hang Su

papers.title: μ0: A Scalable 3D Interaction-Trace World Model
papers.authors: Seungjae Lee, Yoonkyo Jung, Jusuk Lee, Jonghun Shin, Amir Hossein Shahidzadeh, Yao-Chih Lee, H. Jin Kim, Jia-Bin Huang, Furong Huang
papers.published: arXiv submitted 2026-06-11 17:59:56 UTC; 公告批次: 2026-06-15 (Monday, 15 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO, cs.CV, cs.LG
papers.summary: μ0 将机器人世界模型的预测目标从 dense pixels 或 embodiment-specific actions 改成 salient interaction points 的 3D trajectories。TraceExtract 自动从多源视频抽取关键点、全局轨迹和层级语言监督，为跨 embodiment 的 robot learning 提供紧凑 motion interface。
methodHighlights: 3D interaction traces 替代像素未来或直接动作标签。
TraceExtract 自动生成 keypoint、global trace 和 hierarchical language supervision。
视觉语言 backbone 与 3D motion prediction 结合服务 scalable robot learning。

papers.title: WAM4D: Fast 4D World Action Model via Spatial Register Tokens
papers.authors: Ying Li, Xiaobao Wei, Jiajun Cao, Hao Wang, Xiaowei Chi, Chengyu Bai, Qianpu Sun, Jiajun Li, Xiaojie Zhang, Jian Tang, Sirui Han, Shanghang Zhang

methodHighlights: training-time future-depth spatial register tokens 注入几何先验。
推理阶段移除 register branch 保持轻量动作生成。
causal mixture attention 防止非因果捷径。

papers.title: ContactWorld: What Matters in Vision-Tactile World Models for Contact-Rich Manipulation

methodHighlights: 覆盖 insertion、disassembly、screwing 等 contact-rich tasks。
比较 RGB、point cloud 和 tactile representation 对 planning 的影响。
强调 spatial structure 与 temporal continuity。

预测 part segmentation 与 joint motion parameters。
利用异构大规模 articulation 数据提升泛化。

支持 DF-only 和 2DGS-coupled joint DF-rendering。
空间域距离/梯度查询适合 navigation 和 planning。

geometry latents 与 video latents 共享 denoising 空间。

Working/Scene/Skill Memory 维护需求、场景状态和技能。
Inspector 逐步验证，减少局部失败扩散。

papers.title: MooMIns -- Monocular 3D Reconstruction and Object Pose Estimation from Multiple Instances

diffusion loop 内沿轨迹采样 point-wise visual features。

以统一几何标准评估 3DSG room layer。

papers.title: World Tracing: Generative Pixel-Aligned Geometry Beyond the Visible
papers.authors: Hao Zhang, Mohamed El Banani, Jen-Hao Cheng, Paul Zhang, Yi Hua, Ben Mildenhall, Christoph Lassner, Narendra Ahuja, Gengshan Yang
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T17:52:48Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.GR
papers.summary: World Tracing 为每个输入像素预测多层相机空间 3D 点栈，兼顾可见表面忠实性与遮挡几何补全。WT-DiT 通过 flow matching 生成像素对齐几何，在物体、场景和动态 benchmark 上提升完整 3D 生成与 correspondence 保持。
methodHighlights: pixel-aligned multi-layer 3D point stacks 表达可见与遮挡几何。
WT-DiT 结合 factorized/global attention 处理多层几何 token。
mixed noise schedule 平衡可见表面重建和不可见几何生成。

papers.title: Flex4DHuman: Flexible Multi-view Video Diffusion for 4D Human Reconstruction
papers.authors: Jen-Hao Cheng, Yipeng Wang, Hao Zhang, Gengshan Yang, Jenq-Neng Hwang
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T17:54:05Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.GR
papers.summary: Flex4DHuman 用相对相机位姿条件化多视角视频扩散，把单目或稀疏多视角人体视频扩展为密集同步视角。生成视频可直接进入 4D Gaussian Splatting 流程，降低 casual video 到动态 4D asset 的门槛。
methodHighlights: 只用 relative camera-pose conditioning，不依赖显式人体几何先验。
五轴 positional encoding 将 RoPE 扩展到 view 和连续 SE(3) 相机关系。
三阶段课程训练覆盖 pose following、target-view generation 和 temporal rollout。

papers.title: Surflo: Consistent 3D Surface Flow Model with Global State
papers.authors: Antoine Guedon, Shu Nakamura, Nicolas Dufour, Jiahui Lei, Ko Nishino, Angjoo Kanazawa
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T17:48:38Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: Surflo 将变量数量的未定姿 RGB 视图压缩为全局 3D latent state，再用 flow matching 解码任意分辨率有向表面点。推理时 photometric guidance 缓解独立点解码的局部不一致。
methodHighlights: 变量数量未定姿视图到一个 global 3D latent state。
flow matching 生成 oriented surface points，不受固定网格限制。
ODE integration 中引入 photometric-gradient guidance。

papers.title: MoVerse: Real-Time Video World Modeling with Panoramic Gaussian Scaffold
papers.authors: Yang Zhou, Ziheng Wang, Yuqin Lu, Haofeng Liu, Jun Liang, Shengfeng He, Jing Li
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T14:01:02Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: MoVerse 从单张窄视场图像构建可交互漫游的视频世界模型。它先生成 360 度全景，再提升为 persistent 3D Gaussian scaffold，并用条件视频渲染器按用户轨迹实时输出观察。
methodHighlights: world construction 与 observation rendering 解耦。
panoramic Gaussian scaffold 作为持久空间记忆。
bidirectional diffusion teacher 蒸馏为低延迟 causal autoregressive student。

papers.title: Modality Forcing for Scalable Spatial Generation
papers.authors: Bardienus Pieter Duisterhof, Deva Ramanan, Jeffrey Ichnowski, Justin Johnson, Keunhong Park
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T17:59:45Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: Modality Forcing 将 T2I 模型的空间先验转化为 image-depth 联合生成能力。通过每模态独立噪声水平和解码器，它能在稀疏真实 depth 上训练并支持任意条件顺序。
methodHighlights: per-modality noise levels 统一条件生成与联合生成。
per-modality decoders 支持稀疏真实 depth 训练。
从 370M 到 3.3B 参数验证 T2I scale 对 depth 的收益。

papers.title: SpatialClaw: Rethinking Action Interface for Agentic Spatial Reasoning
papers.authors: Seokju Cho, Ryo Hachiuma, Abhishek Badki, Hang Su, Byung-Kwan Lee, Chan Hee Song, Sifei Liu, Subhashree Radhakrishnan, Seungryong Kim, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Min-Hung Chen
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T17:59:36Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.AI
papers.summary: SpatialClaw 用 stateful Python kernel 作为 VLM 的 code-as-action interface，让模型逐步组合感知与几何 primitives。它在 20 个 3D/4D 空间推理 benchmark 上显著超过近期 spatial agent。
methodHighlights: 用 code-as-action interface 替代固定 tool-call schema。
stateful kernel 保存中间观测和分析结果。
训练自由，跨多个 VLM backbone 获得稳定提升。

papers.title: WEAVER, Better, Faster, Longer: An Effective World Model for Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Arnav Kumar Jain, Yilin Wu, Jesse Farebrother, Gokul Swamy, Andrea Bajcsy
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T17:59:15Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO
papers.summary: WEAVER 是面向机器人操作的多视角 world model，同时追求 fidelity、long-horizon consistency 和 efficiency。它用 flow matching 预测未来 latents 和 rewards，并在真实硬件上服务 policy evaluation、improvement 与 planning。
methodHighlights: multi-view latent world model 同时预测未来状态和 reward。
显式面向 long-horizon dynamic manipulation 设计。
硬件验证覆盖策略评估、策略改进和 test-time planning。

papers.title: RepWAM: World Action Modeling with Representation Visual-Action Tokenizers
papers.authors: Junke Wang, Qihang Zhang, Shuai Yang, Yiming Luo, Yujun Shen, Zuxuan Wu, Yu-Gang Jiang, Yinghao Xu
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T17:59:43Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: RepWAM 用 representation visual-action tokenizer 替代纯重建导向视频 tokenizer，让 WAM 同时建模未来视觉状态和连接状态的 latent actions。实验显示语义 visual-action token 更适合真实与仿真闭环操作。
methodHighlights: 视觉状态和 latent actions 进入语义对齐 token 空间。
语言条件下联合建模 future visual states 与 latent actions。
预训练后适配真实机器人轨迹进行闭环控制。

papers.title: MaskWAM: Unifying Mask Prompting and Prediction for World-Action Models
papers.authors: Hanyang Yu, Haitao Lin, Jingbo Zhang, Wenyao Zhang, Chenghao Gu, Heng Li, Ping Tan
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T16:02:42Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.LG, cs.RO
papers.summary: MaskWAM 将 mask 同时作为输入 prompt 和未来预测目标，建立 object-centric world-action model。目标 mask 提供精确空间锚点，future mask prediction 则带来对象级语义监督，提升杂乱与语言歧义场景中的泛化。
methodHighlights: masks 同时作为 visual prompt 和 future prediction target。
Mixture of Transformers 统一 RGB、mask 和 action modeling。
目标物体 mask 降低语言歧义并抑制背景噪声。

papers.title: NavWAM: A Navigation World Action Model for Goal-Conditioned Visual Navigation
papers.authors: Daichi Azuma, Taiki Miyanishi, Koya Sakamoto, Shuhei Kurita, Yaonan Zhu, Petr Khrapchenkov, Motoaki Kawanabe, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T15:44:36Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: NavWAM 把导航世界模型从外部 planner 使用的预测模块改造成可直接输出动作的 diffusion-transformer policy。它在共享 latent sequence 中联合表示未来观察、goal-progress values 和 action chunks。
methodHighlights: future observation、value 和 action chunks 共享 latent sequence。
视觉 foresight 直接服务闭环导航控制。
仿真预训练后进行 real-robot adaptation。

papers.title: Mana: Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Tools
papers.authors: Zhao-Heng Yin, Guanya Shi, Pieter Abbeel, C. Karen Liu
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T17:59:49Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO, cs.AI, cs.CV, cs.LG
papers.summary: Mana 将 articulated tool manipulation 重新表述为动画问题，用低成本 affordance 标注生成 grasp keyframes，再经 motion planning 和 RL 形成操作轨迹。它在四类 articulated tools 上展示零样本 sim-to-real transfer。
methodHighlights: 从功能 affordance 到 grasp keyframes 的自动数据生成。
coarse-to-fine pipeline 结合 motion planning 和 reinforcement learning。
面向不同尺度与关节类型 articulated tools 的灵巧操作。

papers.title: SPARC: Reliable Spatial Annotations from Robot Demonstrations at Scale
papers.authors: Nils Blank, Paul Mattes, Maximilian Xiling Li, Jakub Suliga, Thomas Roth, Moritz Reuss, Pankhuri Vanjani, Rudolf Lioutikov
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-11T15:46:28Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-12 (Friday, 12 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO, cs.CV
papers.summary: SPARC 从机器人示范中自动生成 bounding boxes、object trajectories 和 manipulation phase labels，并为每个标注提供 reliability score。IA-Bench 进一步评测示范中 interacted object grounding，对 embodied foundation models 和真实策略训练都有价值。
methodHighlights: 自动空间标注带 reliability calibration。
利用任务时空结构判断标注可信度。
IA-Bench 衡量机器人示范中的 interacted object grounding。

papers.title: World Pilot: Steering Vision-Language-Action Models with World-Action Priors
papers.authors: Zefu Lin, Rongxu Cui, Junjia Xu, Xiaojuan Jin, Wenling Li, Lue Fan, Zhaoxiang Zhang
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-10T17:59:08Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO
papers.summary: World Pilot 将 World-Action Model 的场景演化和轨迹先验接入 VLA，使策略在当前视觉和语言之外拥有对未来动态的预演。Latent Steering 影响感知层，Action Steering 为动作生成提供轨迹级 motion prior。实验显示它在 LIBERO-Plus 零样本 OOD 和真实机器人任务中提升明显，尤其适合处理视角、几何、形变和位姿变化。
methodHighlights: 用 World-Action Model 同时提供 scene-evolution latent 和 trajectory-level motion prior。
将世界先验分成感知侧 Latent Steering 与动作侧 Action Steering。
证明视频预训练世界模型即便未做 action post-training，也能辅助机器人策略。

papers.title: Making Foresight Actionable: Repurposing Representation Alignment in World Action Models
papers.authors: Lu Qiu, Yizhuo Li, Yi Chen, Yuying Ge, Yixiao Ge, Xihui Liu
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-10T15:31:25Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.AI, cs.RO
papers.summary: 这篇论文指出，WAM 生成合理视频未来并不保证 hidden states 能被动作头正确使用。作者通过 attention analysis 和 causal intervention 发现动作解码器常忽略任务相关交互区域，并受无关区域扰动。AGRA 将视频 diffusion 中间特征与空间语义特征对齐，使世界模型表征更 action-grounded。
methodHighlights: 用因果干预诊断视觉未来和动作可用性的错位。
提出 Action-Grounded Representation Alignment 对齐视频 diffusion 特征和空间语义表示。
提升物体定位、affordance understanding 和 OOD 泛化。

papers.title: TextHOI-3D: Text-to-3D Hand-Object Interaction via Discrete Multi-View Generation and Joint Mesh Optimization
papers.authors: Zixiong Hao, Zhencun Jiang
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-10T08:38:40Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.AI
papers.summary: TextHOI-3D 将文本驱动 3D 生成推进到手-物交互 mesh。它用离散多视图视觉 token 连接文本语义生成和几何恢复，再通过 prior initialization、multi-view joint optimization 和 anti-penetration refinement 恢复 hand-object mesh。多视图设置显著降低 object CD 和 penetration volume。
methodHighlights: 用 discrete multi-view visual tokens 作为文本到 3D HOI 的中间接口。
联合优化手和物体 mesh，并加入 anti-penetration refinement。
同时约束语言语义、多视图一致性、articulated hand shape 和接触合理性。

papers.title: TRON: Tracing Rays to Orchestrate a Neural Renderer for 3D Gaussian Reconstructions
papers.authors: Or Perel, Hassan Abu Alhaija, Zian Wang, Jacob Munkberg, Matan Atzmon, Sanja Fidler, Masha Shugrina
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-09T18:01:02Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.GR
papers.summary: TRON 将 3D Gaussian ray tracing 与 neural rendering 结合，用 ray tracer 提供 radiometric guidance，而不是直接输出最终像素。它利用显式 3D scaffold 和材质先验保留可编辑性，再由轻量神经渲染器弥补真实感差距。目标覆盖 relighting、material editing、object insertion 和动态物体运动。
methodHighlights: 把 3D Gaussian ray tracing 输出作为神经渲染器的结构化指导。
用 inverse rendering 先验正则 Gaussian field 的材质属性。
服务真实捕获 3D 环境中的可控、可编辑渲染。

papers.title: Wild3R: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Unconstrained Sparse Photo Collection
papers.authors: Yuto Furutani, Takashi Otonari, Kaede Shiohara, Toshihiko Yamasaki
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-10T10:23:06Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: Wild3R 面向真实稀疏照片集合中的 feed-forward 3DGS，重点处理光照差异和 transient objects。论文提出 WildCity 数据集，包含 200 个场景、170 种光照条件和 337,500 张图像。模型在 reference views 条件下学习跨视角外观一致性，同时去除临时内容。
methodHighlights: 面向 unconstrained sparse photo collections 的 feed-forward 3DGS。
用 WildCity 数据集覆盖多光照与 transient object 变化。
学习跨视图外观一致性并削弱临时物体污染。

papers.title: DarkVGGT: Seeing Through Darkness Using Thermal Geometry without Daylight Tax
papers.authors: Minseong Kweon, Wenyuan Zhao, Nuo Chen, Lulin Liu, Huiwen Han, Zihao Zhu, Srinivas Shakkottai, Chao Tian, Zhiwen Fan
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-09T18:08:51Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: DarkVGGT 用 RGB-T feed-forward geometry 框架处理低光场景下 RGB 几何线索失效的问题。Physics-inspired thermal factorization 提取更一致的热几何线索，geometry-shared thermal routing 则将可靠结构注入 RGB 流。它提升低可见度下的 depth 和 camera pose 估计，同时尽量保留正常光照表现。
methodHighlights: 通过热因子分解提取 emissive-dominant、geometry-consistent cues。
用 geometry-shared thermal routing 区分通用几何和热成像特有模式。
目标是低光鲁棒但不产生明显 daylight tax。

papers.title: Bridging the Morphology Gap: Adapting VLA Models to Dexterous Manipulation via Intent-Conditioned Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Chuanke Pang, Junyi Huang, Zhijun Zhao, Yaobing Wang, Kun Xu, Xilun Ding
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-10T14:03:52Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO, cs.AI
papers.summary: InDex 解决 VLA 从低自由度平行夹爪迁移到高自由度灵巧手时的 morphology gap。它把预训练 1-DoF grasp 输出重解释为 continuous virtual grasp intent，并用两阶段框架先对齐轨迹和意图，再用 intent-conditioned diffusion head 解码多指关节。这样能保留 VLA 的空间泛化能力并学习接触丰富的灵巧操作。
methodHighlights: 将 parallel gripper grasp 输出作为跨 morphology 的 virtual grasp intent。
两阶段解耦学习: 先空间轨迹和意图，再多指 articulation。
用 intent-conditioned diffusion head 缓解 action manifold collapse。

papers.title: TacCoRL: Integrating Tactile Feedback into VLA via Simulation
papers.authors: Siyu Ma, Yuqi Liang, Chang Yu, Yunuo Chen, Hao Su, Yixin Zhu, Yin Yang, Chenfanfu Jiang
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-10T07:20:36Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO, cs.GR, cs.LG
papers.summary: TacCoRL 将触觉反馈注入 VLA，以处理 contact-rich tasks 中视觉缺失的局部接触状态。它在真实对齐仿真中学习 near-failure states 下触觉应如何调制动作，并用模拟 RL 强化可完成任务的触觉响应。四个双臂接触任务上，visuo-tactile policy 平均成功率从 50.0% 提升到 72.5%。
methodHighlights: 通过 sim-real co-training 和 simulation RL 注入 tactile feedback。
重点学习罕见 near-failure contact states 下的动作修正。
不依赖大规模触觉预训练或在线真实机器人 RL。

papers.title: PLUME: Probabilistic Latent Unified World Modeling and Parameter Estimation for Multi-Finger Manipulation
papers.authors: Abhinav Kumar, Soshi Iba, Rana Soltani Zarrin, Dmitry Berenson
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-09T19:36:25Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO
papers.summary: PLUME 将多指操作中的物体形状、姿态、摩擦等未知物理参数纳入世界模型。它联合学习参数 belief 演化和条件动力学，把物理参数、奖励和部分可观测变量放入统一 latent 表示。部署时通过在线参数推断对齐真实动力学，而不是重新训练或微调。
methodHighlights: 联合建模物理参数 belief 与 dynamics。
通过在线参数推断实现 sim-to-real 对齐。
把 world model、parameter estimation 和 planning 放进同一 latent 空间。

papers.title: VLGA: Vision-Language-Geometry-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jin Yao, Dhruva Dixith Kurra, Tom Lampo, Zezhou Cheng, Danhua Guo, Burhan Yaman
papers.published: arXiv published 2026-06-10T17:57:06Z; 公告批次: 2026-06-11 (Thursday, 11 June 2026); 分类: cs.CV, cs.RO
papers.summary: VLGA 将 geometry 作为自动驾驶 VLA 的第四模态，解决策略缺少 dense 3D grounding 的问题。模型通过 geometry expert 和 LiDAR pointmap regression 监督重建车辆周围 dense 3D world。nuScenes 与 Bench2Drive 结果显示，密集几何监督能降低轨迹误差和碰撞率，并提升闭环驾驶表现。
methodHighlights: 将 geometry 作为 vision-language-action 之外的第四模态。
用 per-pixel pointmap regression against LiDAR 提供 dense 3D supervision。
同时覆盖 open-loop 轨迹预测和 closed-loop driving score。

papers.authors: Xiangru Wu, Ke Fan, Yanwei Fu
papers.published: 公告批次: 2026-05-14 (Thursday, 14 May 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: 这篇工作从 3DGS 的 primitive 形状入手，认为对称 Gaussian 在有限 primitive 预算下会损失边界和单侧结构的表达能力。作者把基础核改成 Azzalini Skew-Normal 之后，用可学习的 skewness 在对称 Gaussian 和更偏置的分布之间连续插值。这样既保留了解析可积性，也能更好地拟合尖边、薄结构和非对称表面。它属于那种看起来是“小改核函数”，但实质上在重新定义 3DGS 表达能力的工作。
methodHighlights: 用 Skew-Normal primitive 替代对称 Gaussian primitive。
通过 bounded skewness 实现连续形状控制。
采用解耦参数化和 block-wise optimization 提升训练稳定性。

papers.title: GaussianZoom: Progressive Zoom-in Generative 3D Gaussian Splatting with Geometric and Semantic Guidance
papers.authors: Jiale Shi, Jiarui Hu, Zesong Yang, Kaixuan Luan, Hujun Bao, Zhaopeng Cui
papers.published: 公告批次: 2026-05-18 (Monday, 18 May 2026); 分类: cs.CV
papers.summary: GaussianZoom 把“极限放大”当成 3D 重建问题来做，而不是单纯的超分或后处理。作者用多视图一致的 super-resolution 模块配合 depth-based feature warping 和 VLM-driven detail synthesis，让局部细节在多视图间仍保持一致。再加上可扩展的 continuous LoD 层级，模型能够在更大放大倍率下保持平滑、无锯齿的跨尺度渲染。它对 3D 生成和场景重建都很有启发，因为它把几何和语义一起纳入了 zoom-in 过程。
methodHighlights: 结合几何一致性和语义引导做 progressive zoom-in 重建。
用连续 LoD hierarchy 控制 Gaussian 可见性和跨尺度过渡。
强调极端放大时的多视图一致性，而不是只追单帧观感。

papers.title: GraspFoM: Towards Reconstruction-Driven Robotic Grasping with 3D Foundation Priors
papers.authors: Dongli Wu, Xiaobao Wei, Hao Wang, Qiaochu Dong, Ying Li, Qingpo Wuwu, Ming Lu, Wufan Zhao
papers.published: 公告批次: 2026-06-07 (Sunday, 7 June 2026); 分类: cs.RO, cs.CV
